column1: # Northern Kurdish (Kurmanji) interface catalogue, in the Latin script.
# english<TAB>translation; a line left out falls through to English.
# PART OF THE INTERFACE, ON PURPOSE: only the words its writer was sure of.
# NOT YET REVIEWED BY A KURDISH SPEAKER, so the picker says so. Additions and

column2: ji bo betalkirinê Esc an N
ji bo girtinê Ctrl+D an Esc

column1: # What the desk face says when you switch to this language: a local saying, not a translation.
Dobar den, skapi. I am Dr. Pixel. Five minutes, and you will run a show. Less, if you listen to me.
column2: Dobar den, skapi. Rojbaş! Ez Dr. Pixel im. Pênc deqe, û tu dê şanoyekê bimeşînî. Kêmtir, eger tu guh bidî min.

column1: And I'm Professor Video. Synths first, then video. Mostly video now. Press START and we'll patch... we'll begin.
column2: Û ez Profesor Video me. Pêşî synth, paşê vîdyo. Niha bi piranî vîdyo. START bitikîne, em ê girê bidin... dest pê bikin.

column1: Skapi, the screen is empty. Don't keep them waiting. Open MENU and make OUTPUT OFF say OUTPUT ON. Aide!
column2: Skapi, ekran vala ye. Wan li bendê nehêle. MENÛ veke û OUTPUT OFF bike OUTPUT ON. Hajde!

column1: Lesson one: nothing comes out until you patch the oscillator to the... the OUTPUT. It's video. I know.
column2: Dersa yekem: heta tu oscillator negihînî... OUTPUT-ê, tiştek dernakeve. Vîdyo ye. Dizanim.

column1: Now a picture. Press I and pick a clip from your computer. No clip? SHOW ME, and I lend you one of mine.
column2: Niha wêneyek. I bitikîne û ji komputera xwe klîpekê hilbijêre. Klîp tune? SHOW ME, ez ê yek ji yên xwe bidim te.

column1: Every clip becomes a cue in the playlist. Like loading a sample. A sample with pictures in it.
column2: Her klîp dibe cue di playlistê de. Wek barkirina sample. Sample bi wêneyan.

column1: Your clip waits in the playlist. Select it, then TAKE. Or Enter. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: Klîpa te di playlistê de li bendê ye. Hilbijêre, paşê TAKE. An jî Enter. Operatorên bi bawerî Enter dixin.

column1: TAKE is the envelope trigger. The, ah, the GO button. Same thing, it just has pictures in it.
column2: TAKE tetika envelope ye. Bişkoka GO, ê. Heman tişt, tenê bi wêneyan.

column1: Click another cue. It waits, ready, until you say. Only one cue? Import another, or SHOW ME.
column2: Li cue-yeke din bitikîne. Amade li bendê ye heta tu bibêjî. Tenê cue-yek? Yeke din BÎNE HUNDIR, an jî SHOW ME.

column1: Selecting is not playing. The selected one is the next note in the sequence. The next CUE.
column2: Hilbijartin ne lêdan e. Ya hilbijartî nota din a rêzê ye. CUE-ya din.

column1: Cuts are for amateurs. In the inspector, press + on transition, so it shows a time, not deck. Then TAKE.
column2: Birrîna hişk ji bo amatoran e. Di inspector de li ser transition + bitikîne, da ku dem xuya bibe, ne deck. Paşê TAKE.

column1: A crossfade! Portamento, but for pictures. Any time will do. A few more presses and it's a second. Then TAKE.
column2: Crossfade! Portamento, lê ji bo wêneyan. Her dem baş e. Çend tikandinên din û saniyeyek e. Paşê TAKE.

column1: Something goes wrong on stage? Press BLACK, or B. The picture goes. The show keeps running underneath.
column2: Li ser sehnê tiştek xelet çû? BLACK bitikîne, an jî B. Wêne diçe. Şano li jêr dewam dike.

column1: Nothing is lost. Press B again and it comes back. Like the mute on a mixer. Very calming.
column2: Tiştek winda nabe. Dîsa B bitikîne, vedigere. Wek mute li ser mixer. Pir aram e.

column1: Now save. Ctrl+S, or SAVE. Some programs lose your work and then blame you. I would never.
column2: Niha tomar bike. Ctrl+S, an jî TOMAR BIKE. Hin bername karê te winda dikin û paşê te sûcdar dikin. Ez qet.

column1: Save your patch. Your SHOW. Show. This practice one lives in Deckboy's own folder; yours is safe.
column2: Patch-a xwe tomar bike. ŞANOYA xwe. Şano. Ev ya ceribandinê di peldanka Deckboy de dijî; ya te ewle ye.

column1: That's a show! Output, cue, TAKE, crossfade, BLACK, save. Nazdrave, skapi. Rakia is on me.
column2: Ev şanoyek e! Output, cue, TAKE, crossfade, BLACK, tomar. Nazdrave, skapi. Rakia li ser min. Ji araqê xurtir e, hişyar be.

column1: Class dismissed. The example shows teach layers, titles and effects. MENU > LEARN THE BASICS runs this again.
column2: Ders qediya. Şanoyên mînak layer, sernav û efektan hîn dikin. MENÛ > LEARN THE BASICS dîsa dimeşîne.
*serê xwe dihejîne* Ev tê wateya erê. Bijî!

column1: Mm. I knew you had it in you.
column2: Mm. Min dizanî ku tu dikarî.

column1: Yes! Have a gold star. It's a dot.
column2: Erê! Stêrkeke zêr ji te re. Xalek e.

column1: Ready for the next step? *nods* ...That means no, skapi. The glowing one. It is glowing for you.
column2: Ji bo gava din amade yî? *serê xwe ber bi jêr dihejîne* ...Li Bulgaristanê ev na ye, skapi. Ya ku dibiriqe. Ji bo te dibiriqe.

column1: You've clicked everything but the glowing one. Even my oscillators find the glowing one.
column2: Te li her tiştî tikand ji bilî ya ku dibiriqe. Heta oscillatorên min jî ya ku dibiriqe dibînin.

column1: stop playback first - the lesson cannot hand a running show back as it was
column2: pêşî lêdanê rawestîne - ders nikare şanoyeke ku dimeşe wek berê vegerîne

column1: choose RECOVER or KEEP SAVED first
column2: pêşî RECOVER an KEEP SAVED hilbijêre

column1: your show could not be saved, so the lesson has not started. Save it (SAVE AS) and try again
column2: şanoya te nehate tomarkirin, ji ber vê ders dest pê nekir. Tomar bike (TOMAR BIKE WEK) û dîsa biceribîne

column1: the practice show would not open
could not start the practice show
learn the basics: Esc leaves, and it picks up here next time
column2: learn the basics: Esc derdikeve, cara din ji vir dewam dike

column1: that's the basics - MENU > LESSONS has part two
column2: ev bingeh e - MENÛ > LESSONS beşa duyem heye

column1: tour paused - LEARN THE BASICS picks up where you left off
column2: ger rawestî - LEARN THE BASICS ji cihê ku te hişt dewam dike

column1: Mirrored screens, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Ekranên neynikî, skapi. Her bişkokekê bitikîne an bikirtîne, Dr. Pixel wê vedigerîne.

column1: Wrong screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Ekrana xelet, skapi. Her bişkokekê bitikîne an bikirtîne, Dr. Pixel wê vedigerîne.

column1: The other screen went away, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Ekrana din çû, skapi. Her bişkokekê bitikîne an bikirtîne, Dr. Pixel wê vedigerîne.

column1: One screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: Ekranek, skapi. Her bişkokekê bitikîne an bikirtîne, Dr. Pixel wê vedigerîne.

column1: The other screen went away, skapi, so the picture came back to this one. I put it in a little window, behind. Plug it back in and the picture goes back on it.
column2: Ekrana din çû, skapi, ji ber vê wêne vegeriya vê. Min ew xist pencereyeke biçûk, li paş. Dîsa girê bide û wêne vedigere ser wê.

column1: It ate the desk, skapi. One screen, so the output took all of it. I put it in a little window, behind. A real show gets a second screen.
column2: Mase xwar, skapi. Ekranek, ji ber vê output hemû girt. Min ew xist pencereyeke biçûk, li paş. Şanoyeke rastîn ekrana duyem digire.

column1: There. The button that says OUTPUT OFF. Make it say ON, skapi.
column2: Li wir. Bişkoka ku OUTPUT OFF dibêje. Bike ON, skapi.

column1: Nothing is live to fade from, skapi. TAKE one cue first, then pick the other and give it a time.
column2: Tiştek li çapê nîne ku jê fade bibe, skapi. Pêşî cue-yekê TAKE bike, paşê ya din hilbijêre û demekê bide.

column1: That was a cut, skapi. Fast, but not a crossfade. Pick the other cue, press + on transition, then TAKE.
column2: Ew birrînek bû, skapi. Bilez, lê ne crossfade. Cue-ya din hilbijêre, li ser transition + bitikîne, paşê TAKE.

column1: A feedback loop! Output patched straight back into the desk. Happens to the best of us. Mostly to me. 1983. We don't talk about 1983.
column2: Xeleka feedback! Output rasterast vegeriya masê. Ji yên herî baş re jî diqewime. Bi piranî ji min re. 1983. Em behsa 1983-an nakin.

column1: No more rakia. The rat has a problem.
column2: Êdî rakia tune. Pirsgirêka mişkê mezin heye.

column1: Nazdrave, skapi! Baba's rakia, from Belogradchik. One glass, for the lesson.
column2: Nazdrave, skapi! Rakia ya dapîrê, ji Belogradçîkê. Qedehek, ji bo dersê. Paşê çayek, ji bo hişyariyê.

column1: Is this... is this allowed during a tutorial?
column2: Ev... ev di dersê de destûr e?
*serê xwe dihejîne* Ev tê wateya yeke din.

column1: I love you all. I love the oscillator. I love the OUTPUT. It's video. I know. I KNOW.
column2: Ez ji we hemûyan hez dikim. Ji oscillator hez dikim. Ji OUTPUT hez dikim. Vîdyo ye. Dizanim. DIZANIM.

column1: ...and the rat took the rakia. Every time, skapi. Every single time.
column2: ...û mişkê mezin rakia bir. Her car, skapi. Her car.

column1: Was that a rat? In a hat? With a pizza?
column2: Ew mişkê mezin bû? Bi kum? Bi pizza?

column1: Stop that. I am a serious man.
column2: Bes e. Ez mirovekî cidî me.

column1: Do not tell Dr. Pixel about this.
This never happened. Back to the patch bay.
column2: Ev qet nebû. Vegere patch bay.

column1: It was the eighties. Everyone had a bow tie.
column2: Salên heştêyî bûn. Her kesî papyon hebû.

column1: CHECK a show before it travels, fix what it finds, and bundle it with its media.
column2: Berî rêwîtiyê CHECK bike, çi dibîne çêke, û bi medyaya wê re BUNDLE bike.

column1: An effect, a ~ on its knob, and the colour picker.
column2: Efektek, ~ li ser bişkoka wê, û hilbijêra rengan.

column1: The art school crit, with Mr. Salty
column2: Rexneya dibistana hunerê, bi Mr. Salty re

column1: A test pattern, the video synth, and drawing on the picture, saved as a still.
column2: Wêneyê testê, synth-a vîdyoyê, û xêzkirin li ser wêneyê, wek wêneyekî rawestî tomar.

column1: The telestrator booth, with Coach Marv
column2: Kabîna telestrator, bi Coach Marv re

column1: A heart from the library, the pen, invert and feather.
column2: Dilek ji pirtûkxaneyê, pênûs, berevajîkirin û nermkirin.

column1: The Signal Files: redact the evidence
A corner pin, two soft edges, then three slices in the Screens window.
column2: Corner pin, du kêlekên nerm, paşê sê slice di pencereya Screens de.

column1: The haunted lighthouse, with Keeper Rook
column2: Fenera bi xeyal, bi fenerdar Rook re

column1: Cue numbers, GOTO, a hotkey, and where Companion, MIDI and OSC come in.
column2: Hejmarên cue, GOTO, bişkokeke kurt, û Companion, MIDI û OSC ji ku tên.

column1: The game show, with Donna Wheel
column2: Pêşbirka televizyonê, bi Donna Wheel re

column1: A Lower Third with a name on it, then a title card with a key-green backdrop.
column2: Lower Third bi navekî, paşê kartek sernavê bi paşxaneya kesk a key.

column1: The kaiju weather report, with June O'Neil
column2: Hewaya kaiju, bi June O'Neil re

column1: A stage timer counting down, held, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Demjimêra sehnê ku dijmêre, rawestandî, û dîmena pêşkêşvan ji bo kesê li ser sehnê.

column1: A grand day out, with Wallis and Grommet
column2: Rojeke mezin, bi Wallis û Grommet re

column1: A second playlist as a layer, and TAKE ALL so two things change on one beat.
column2: Playlista duyem wek layer, û TAKE ALL da ku du tişt di heman lêdanê de biguherin.

column1: The magic show, with Turnip Top
column2: Şanoya sêrbaziyê, bi Turnip Top re

column1: BLACK against PANIC, and getting a show back.
column2: BLACK li hember PANIC, û vegerandina şanoyê.

column1: The cooking show, with Chef Bork
column2: Şanoya xwarinçêkirinê, bi Chef Bork re

column1: Capture a look on a DASH button, change everything, and get it back with one press.
column2: Xuyangekê li ser bişkoka DASH bigire, her tiştî biguherîne, û bi tikandinekê vegerîne.

column1: The styles beyond the crossfade: an iris, a shatter, and their times.
column2: Şêwazên piştî crossfade: iris, shatter, û demên wan.

column1: The space-opera trailer, with Optimus Primetime
column2: Trailera operaya fezayê, bi Optimus Primetime re

column1: An audio effect on a cue, a bend that damages it beautifully, and where the patch lives.
column2: Efekteke deng li ser cue, bendek ku wê bi xweşikî xera dike, û patch li ku dijî.

column1: The robot DJs, with Deft Funk
column2: DJ-yên robot, bi Deft Funk re

column1: The waveform, the vectorscope, and false colour: is the glow real, or just too bright?
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, û rengê derewîn: ronî rast e, an tenê pir geş e?

column1: The Signal Files: is the glow on the horizon a craft?
column2: Pelên Sînyalê: ronahiya li ser asoyê keştî ye?

column1: Where NDI, SDI and ST 2110 live, and NDI switched on where this computer has it.
column2: NDI, SDI û ST 2110 li ku dijîn, û NDI vekirî li cihê ku ev komputer heye.

column1: The webcam as a controller, as a game. Five rounds, a high score.
column2: Webcam wek kontrol, wek lîstik. Pênc dor, skora herî bilind.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, what each one shows, layouts, and tally.
column2: Pencere, menuya ..., her yek çi nîşan dide, layout û tally.

column1: Mystery on the starship Cathode, with Lt. Haila and Ensign Jinkley
column2: Razek li ser keştiya fezayê Cathode, bi Lt. Haila û Ensign Jinkley re

column1: DR. PIXEL: Two playlists: Deckboy becomes SUPER DECKBOY. It earned it, skapi.
column2: DR. PIXEL: Du playlist: Deckboy dibe SUPER DECKBOY. Heq kir, skapi.

column1: PROF. VIDEO: It evolved! My oscillators never got a fanfare.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: Pêşve çû! Oscillatorên min qet fanfare negirtin.

column1: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Every show deserves one. Bravo.
column2: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Her şano heq dike. Bijî!

column1: PROF. VIDEO: The power-up! More playlists, more layers, more super.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: Hêz! Playlist zêdetir, layer zêdetir, super zêdetir.

column1: Intro video (left on the office PC)
column2: Vîdyoya destpêkê (li ser PC-ya ofîsê ma)

column1: A show you built here, skapi, running on a laptop somewhere else tonight. Press START.
column2: Şanoyek ku te li vir çêkir, skapi, îşev li ser laptopekê li cihekî din dimeşe. START bitikîne.

column1: Before it travels: check it, fix it, bundle it.
column2: Berî rêwîtiyê: kontrol bike, çêke, bipêçe.

column1: See CHECK in the top bar? It only appears when something is wrong. Press it.
column2: CHECK li barê jor dibînî? Tenê dema tiştek xelet be xuya dibe. Bitikîne.

column1: It lists everything a show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, unreachable outputs.
column2: Her tiştê ku şano pê biterpile rêz dike: pelên winda, cue-yên vala, outputên negihîştî.

column1: The intro video is on another computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: Vîdyoya destpêkê li ser komputereke din e. Hilbijêre û jê bibe, an jî eger pel bi te re be RELINK bike.

column1: Fix it at home, where it is easy. Not at the venue, where it is not.
column2: Li malê çêke, li wir hêsan e. Ne li cihê şanoyê, li wir ne hêsan e.

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, together.
column2: BUNDLE bitikîne û cih hilbijêre: USB, peldankeke hevpar. Şano û hemû medyaya wê, bi hev re.

column1: The copy finds its media beside it, wherever the folder goes.
column2: Kopî medyaya xwe li kêleka xwe dibîne, peldank biçe ku derê jî.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other machine, open the bundle's show: everything is where it should be.
column2: Kontrolkirî, çêkirî, pêçayî. Li ser makîneya din şanoya pakêtê veke: her tişt li cihê xwe ye.

column1: A show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the heavy part.
column2: Pelê şanoyê tenê nivîs e, sivik diçe. Ya giran medya ye.

column1: An art school, skapi. One student, one picture, one critic who has seen it all. Press START.
column2: Dibistaneke hunerê, skapi. Xwendekarek, wêneyek, rexnegirek ku her tişt dîtiye. START bitikîne.

column1: Effects change a picture; an oscillator keeps changing it. The critic only likes the second kind.
column2: Efekt wêneyê diguherînin; oscillator wê her tim diguherîne. Rexnegir tenê ji ya duyem hez dike.

column1: A grey square on beige. I have seen this at every graduate show since 1987.
column2: Çargoşeyeke gewr li ser bej. Ji 1987-an ve li her pêşangeha mezûnbûnê dîtiye.

column1: In the inspector's EFFECTS section, + adds one. Edges is a good start: it draws the outlines.
column2: Di beşa EFFECTS a inspector de, + yekê zêde dike. Edges destpêkeke baş e: xêzan xêz dike.

column1: There are dozens. Every one runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. Mostly.
column2: Bi dehan hene. Her yek li ser CPU di çend milîsaniyeyan de dixebite. Bi piranî.

column1: Take a risk! Bad art is fine. Boring art is a crime.
column2: Xetereyê bigire! Hunera xirab baş e. Hunera bêzar sûc e.

column1: Every control with a ~ beside it can follow an oscillator. Press one. The knob starts to breathe.
column2: Her kontrola ku ~ li kêleka wê ye dikare li pey oscillator here. Yekê bitikîne. Bişkok dest bi bêhnê dike.

column1: A low-frequency oscillator: slow, so the eye can follow it. A quarter of a hertz is a four-second breath.
column2: Oscillatoreke frekansa nizm: hêdî, da ku çav bişopîne. Çaryeka hertzê bêhneke çar saniyeyan e.

column1: Now it MOVES. Okay. Okay. I'm listening.
column2: Niha dilive. Baş e. Baş e. Ez guhdarî dikim.

column1: Effects that draw a colour, like Edges' line, have a colour chip. It opens the picker: a wheel, typed names, or a colour off the screen.
column2: Efektên ku rengek xêz dikin, wek xêza Edges, xwedî çîpeke rengî ne. Hilbijêrê vedike: çerx, navên nivîsandî, an rengek ji ekranê.

column1: Every colour has a name somewhere. Mine is 'oscilloscope green'. Nobody else uses it.
column2: Her reng li cihekî navek heye. Ya min 'kesk oscilloscope' e. Kesek din bi kar nayne.

column1: That colour is doing something. I don't know what. I love it.
column2: Ew reng tiştekî dike. Nizanim çi. Ez jê hez dikim.

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying, skapi. Good crying, I think.
column2: Efektek, ~ û rengek. Rexnegir digirî, skapi. Girîna baş, ez difikirim.

column1: Stack a few. Each has its own ~ on every knob. That is how a look becomes a performance.
column2: Çendan li ser hev deyne. Her yek ~ ya xwe li ser her bişkokê heye. Wiha xuyang dibe şano.

column1: It's still a square. But it's YOUR square. Post it.
column2: Hîn jî çargoşe ye. Lê çargoşeya TE ye. Biweşîne.

column1: Coach Marv explains sport by drawing circles on it. Once he circled the sun. Ten minutes, skapi.
column2: Coach Marv werzişê bi xêzkirina bazineyan li ser wê rave dike. Carekê dora rojê xêz kir. Deh deqe, skapi.

column1: Tonight: test patterns, the video synth, and drawing on the picture. Press START.
column2: Îşev: wêneyên testê, synth-a vîdyoyê, û xêzkirin li ser wêneyê. START bitikîne.

column1: Get me a picture and a pen. BOOM.
column2: Wêneyek û pênûsek bidin min. BÛM.

column1: Line up the screens BEFORE the show. Not during. I learned this in Plovdiv.
column2: Ekranan BERÎ şanoyê rast bike. Ne di navê de. Min ev li Plovdivê hîn bû.

column1: Every desk needs a test pattern. PATTERN adds Pocket Test: checked against real meters.
column2: Her mase hewceyî wêneyekî testê ye. PATTERN Pocket Test zêde dike: bi pîvanên rastîn hatiye kontrolkirin.

column1: He says 'no camera needed' like it is a feature. It is a feature.
column2: Ew dibêje 'kamera ne hewce ye' wek ku taybetmendiyek be. Taybetmendî ye.

column1: My favourite. SOURCE, then Video Synth: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. No camera needed.
column2: Ya min a herî hezkirî. ÇAVKANÎ, paşê Video Synth: oscillator, neynik û feedback. Kamera ne hewce ye.

column1: Select it, then TAKE. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: Hilbijêre, paşê TAKE. Operatorên bi bawerî Enter dixin.

column1: That's our replay. Every replay needs a pundit.
column2: Ev dubarekirina me ye. Her dubarekirin hewceyî şîrovekarekî ye.

column1: Now here's a replay. And here's a guy. And BOOM, he's in it.
column2: Va ye dubarekirin. Va ye lîstikvan. Û BÛM, ew tê de ye.

column1: Ink goes on top, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Mîrekeb li jor diçe, li ser layer-a xwe. + li dawiya tabên playlistan bitikîne.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first. Like a second oscillator, mixed on top.
column2: Playlista duyem layerek e li ser ya yekem. Wek oscillatora duyem, li jor tê tevlihevkirin.

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Draw. Clear everywhere you have not drawn.
column2: Di playlista nû de: ÇAVKANÎ, paşê Draw. Li her cihê ku te xêz nekiriye zelal e.

column1: A Draw cue is transparent outside the ink, so the synth shows through.
column2: Draw cue li derveyî mîrekebê zelal e, ji ber vê synth xuya dibe.

column1: Select the Draw cue and TAKE it. Two playlists, two layers, one picture.
column2: Draw cue hilbijêre û TAKE bike. Du playlist, du layer, yek wêne.

column1: Now both are live: the synth underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Niha her du jî li çapê ne: synth li jêr, mîrekeb li jor.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then draw on the programme monitor. Mouse, or a pen if you have one.
column2: Di inspector de DRAW bitikîne, paşê li ser monitora bernameyê xêz bike. Bi mişkê, an pênûsê eger hebe.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength. Like me.
column2: Zexta pênûsê xêzê qalind dike. Mişk her tim bi heman hêzê zext dike. Wek min.

column1: Circle him! No, bigger. BOOM. That's a cloud. Fine. Circle the cloud.
column2: Dora wî bazine bike! Na, mezintir. BÛM. Ew ewr e. Baş e. Dora ewr bazine bike.

column1: SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, and adds it to the playlist.
column2: SAVE STILL xêzkirinê wek wêneyekî bi paşxaneya zelal diparêze û li playlistê zêde dike.

column1: For next week's show. Coach Marv will want the cloud again.
column2: Ji bo bernameya hefteya bê. Coach Marv dê dîsa ewr bixwaze.

column1: Patterns, the synth, a layer, ink, a still. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Wêneyên testê, synth, layerek, mîrekeb, wêneyekî rawestî. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: Try Replay in the Draw section: it draws your lines back the way you drew them.
column2: Replay di beşa Draw de biceribîne: xêzên te wek ku te xêz kirine dîsa xêz dike.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen. And a turducken.
column2: Hefteya bê heman dem. Pênûseke mezintir bîne. Û tasek dolme.

column1: The Bureau of Unexplained Signals. Two agents, one photo, and it must not air. Press START.
column2: Buroya Sînyalên Nediyar. Du ajan, yek wêne, û divê neçe çapê. START bitikîne.

column1: Masks cut a picture into shapes. Tonight we cut evidence.
column2: Mask wêneyekî dikin şekil. Îşev em delîlan dibirin.

column1: That's a craft, Brandt. Look at the lights. I want to believe.
column2: Ew keştî ye, Brandt. Li ronahiyan binêre. Ez dixwazim bawer bikim.

column1: In the inspector's MASK section: mask, then 'new heart'. Any shape will do. The heart is funnier.
column2: Di beşa MASK a inspector de: mask, paşê 'new heart'. Her şekil baş e. Dil kenoktir e.

column1: The library has circles, stars, hearts. Each one is points you can move.
column2: Pirtûkxane bazine, stêrk, dil hene. Her yek xalên ku tu dikarî bilivînî ne.

column1: A heart, Hollis? The Bureau redacts with black bars.
column2: Dil, Hollis? Buro bi barên reş vedişêre.

column1: Set the tool to pen, then click round the saucer on the monitor. Click the first point to close it.
column2: Amûrê bike pênûs, paşê li ser monitorê dora firokeyê bitikîne. Ji bo girtinê li xala yekem bitikîne.

column1: Click for corners, drag for curves. The way the Bezier brothers intended.
column2: Ji bo goşeyan bitikîne, ji bo xêzên xwar bikişîne. Wek ku birayên Bézier dixwestin.

column1: Draw round it carefully. It might be watching.
column2: Bi baldarî dora wê xêz bike. Dibe ku temaşe dike.

column1: Invert keeps the outside and cuts the inside. The saucer goes. The sky stays.
column2: Berevajîkirin derve diparêze û hundir dibire. Firoke diçe. Ezman dimîne.

column1: The same shape, the other way round. Very useful. Slightly spooky.
column2: Heman şekil, berevajî. Pir bi kêr. Hinekî tirsnak.

column1: Hollis, there's a heart-shaped hole in the sky.
column2: Hollis, di ezman de qulek bi şeklê dil heye.

column1: Feather softens the edge, so nobody sees the cut. Press + on feather.
column2: Nermkirin kêlekê nerm dike, da ku kes birrînê nebîne. Li ser feather + bitikîne.

column1: A hard edge says 'someone was here'. A soft one says nothing at all.
column2: Kêleka hişk dibêje 'kesek li vir bû'. Ya nerm tiştek nabêje.

column1: A library shape, the pen, invert and feather. The Bureau thanks you. The Bureau was never here.
column2: Şekleke pirtûkxaneyê, pênûs, berevajîkirin û nermkirin. Buro spas dike. Buro qet ne li vir bû.

column1: Masks also go on a layer, an output, or its matte: MASK ON chooses. And every control takes a ~.
column2: Mask dikarin li ser layer, output an matte-ya wê jî biçin: MASK ON hildibijêre. Û her kontrol ~ digire.

column1: The truth is in the waveform, Hollis. Next time, the scopes.
column2: Rastî di waveform de ye, Hollis. Cara din, scope.

column1: A lighthouse, a ghost, and a keeper who has been alone with the lamp far too long. Press START.
column2: Fenerek, xeyalek, û fenerdarek ku pir dirêj bi tenê bi çirayê re maye. START bitikîne.

column1: Projection mapping: bending the picture to fit the building. Warp, blend, slices.
column2: Projection mapping: wêneyê xwar dikin da ku li avahiyê bê. Warp, blend, slice.

column1: Ye'll be wanting the ghost on the windows. Mind the lamp. The lamp is MINE.
column2: Hûn xeyalê li ser pencereyan dixwazin, ne wisa? Hay ji çirayê hebin. Çira YA MIN e.

column1: MENU, then Video Outputs, then Geometry. Where an output's shape lives.
column2: MENÛ, paşê Video Outputs, paşê Geometry. Şeklê outputê li wir dijî.

column1: Geometry: the projector-menu word for 'what shape is the picture'.
column2: Geometry: peyva menuya projektorê ji bo 'wêne çi şekil e'.

column1: Press warp edit, then drag a corner on the programme monitor. The window is not square. Neither is the keeper.
column2: warp edit bitikîne, paşê goşeyekê li ser monitora bernameyê bikişîne. Pencere ne çargoşe ye. Fenerdar jî ne.

column1: A corner pin moves the four corners. Perspective keeps the lines straight, like a real window.
column2: Corner pin çar goşeyan dilivîne. Perspektîf xêzan rast dihêle, wek pencereyeke rastîn.

column1: LEFT! Ye call that a corner? I've seen straighter gulls.
column2: ÇEP! Tu vê goşe dibêjî? Min qijikên rastir dîtine.

column1: Back in Geometry: edge blend, + on the left and + on the right.
column2: Vegere Geometry: edge blend, li çepê + û li rastê +.

column1: Two projectors overlap; each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright.
column2: Du projektor li ser hev dikevin; her yek kêleka xwe kal dike da ku cihê hevpar du qat geş nebe.

column1: Geometry, SLICES, open. The Screens window is where slices are cut and placed.
column2: Geometry, SLICES, veke. Pencereya Screens cihê ku slice tên birrîn û danîn e.

column1: A slice is a piece of the picture, put anywhere on the output.
column2: Slice perçeyek wêneyê ye, li her cihê outputê tê danîn.

column1: In the Screens window, + SLICE three times, and drag each crop to a third of the picture.
column2: Di pencereya Screens de, sê caran + SLICE, û her birrînê bikişîne sêyeka wêneyê.

column1: Three windows, three slices: left, middle and right of one picture.
column2: Sê pencere, sê slice: çep, navîn û rastê wêneyekî.

column1: Three windows. The lamp gets the middle one. The lamp ALWAYS gets the middle one.
column2: Sê pencere. Ya navîn ya çirayê ye. Ya navîn HER TIM ya çirayê ye.

column1: Warp, blend, slices. The keeper will finally sleep. The gulls will not.
column2: Warp, blend, slice. Fenerdar dê di dawiyê de razê. Qijik na.

column1: Slices have their own warp and mesh in the Screens window. And a ~ on the place and the turn.
column2: Slice warp û mesh-a xwe di pencereya Screens de hene. Û ~ li ser cih û zivirînê.

column1: Ye did alright, lad. Now get away from the lamp.
column2: Te baş kir, kuro. Niha ji çirayê dûr bikeve.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and cues that fire from anywhere. Press START.
column2: Pêşbirkeke televizyonê, skapi. Sê pêşbirkvan, buzzerek, û cue-yên ku ji her derê diteqin. START bitikîne.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines. Like a sequencer you can play from any key.
column2: Hejmarên cue, bişkokên kurt, û GO ji makîneyên din. Wek sequencer ku tu bi her bişkokê lê dixî.

column1: Welcome to the show! Let's spin that wheel!
column2: Hûn bi xêr hatin şanoyê! Werin em çerxê bizivirînin!

column1: Contestant 3 is selected. In the inspector's metadata, give it a cue number: 3.
column2: Pêşbirkvan 3 hilbijartî ye. Di metadata ya inspector de hejmareke cue bide: 3.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Şano cue-yên xwe hejmar dike. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy hemûyan dixwîne.

column1: I'd like to buy a number, please.
column2: Ez dixwazim hejmarekê bikirim, ji kerema xwe.

column1: Ctrl+G, type the number, Enter. It goes live wherever the list happens to be standing.
column2: Ctrl+G, hejmarê binivîse, Enter. Diçe çapê, lîste li ku be jî.

column1: GOTO. The fastest way across a long list. Faster than scrolling. Much faster than me.
column2: GOTO. Rêya herî bilez di lîsteyeke dirêj de. Ji scroll bileztir. Ji min pir bileztir.

column1: Contestant 1 is selected. In TRIGGERS, press key, then F5. That key now fires this cue.
column2: Pêşbirkvan 1 hilbijartî ye. Di TRIGGERS de key bitikîne, paşê F5. Ew bişkok niha vê cue diteqîne.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one, a buzzer.
column2: F1 heta F10, F12, an pada hejmaran. Her yek buzzerek e.

column1: Press the key. The cue fires, wherever the list is standing.
column2: Bişkokê bitikîne. Cue diteqe, lîste li ku be jî.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Just the key.
column2: Bê mişk, bê lîste, bê nihêrîn. Tenê bişkok.

column1: Companion, a MIDI note, an OSC message: MENU, then Network, says where each one connects.
column2: Companion, notayeke MIDI, peyameke OSC: MENÛ, paşê Tor, dibêje her yek li ku girê dide.

column1: A Stream Deck in the next room can press GO. So can a keyboard synth. I prefer the synth.
column2: Stream Deck di odeya kêlekê de dikare GO bitikîne. Synth-a klavyeyê jî. Ez synth tercîh dikim.

column1: And for our viewers at home: you can play along too.
column2: Û ji bo temaşevanên li malê: hûn jî dikarin bilîzin.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You are a game show now, skapi.
column2: Hejmar, GOTO, buzzer, û GO ji her derê. Niha tu pêşbirkeke televizyonê yî, skapi.

column1: A cue can have a key, a MIDI note and an OSC address at once. Belt, braces and a second belt.
column2: Cue dikare bişkok, notaya MIDI û navnîşana OSC bi hev re hebin. Kember, beng û kembereke din.
Şev baş, her kes! Zivirandinê bidomînin!

column1: Channel 6 weather, skapi. A map, a presenter, and a very large lizard. Press START.
column2: Hewaya Kanala 6, skapi. Nexşeyek, pêşkêşvanek, û marmarokeke pir mezin. START bitikîne.

column1: Words on screen: Lower Thirds, text, and backdrops.
column2: Peyv li ser ekranê: Lower Third, nivîs û paşxane.

column1: I'm June O'Neil, and nothing about this forecast is normal.
column2: Ez June O'Neil im, û di vê pêşbîniyê de tiştek ne asayî ye.

column1: Words go on their own layer: press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Peyv li ser layer-a xwe diçin: + li dawiya tabên playlistan bitikîne.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. Mostly.
column2: Playlista duyem layerek e li ser nexşeyê. Marmarok li jêr dimîne. Bi piranî.

column1: Words on top. Always on top.
column2: Peyv li jor. Her tim li jor.

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Lower Third.
column2: Di playlista nû de: ÇAVKANÎ, paşê Lower Third.

column1: A name and a title, low on the screen, out of the lizard's way.
column2: Nav û sernavek, li jêrê ekranê, ji rêya marmarokê dûr.

column1: In the inspector, title: type the presenter's name. The second line is her job.
column2: Di inspector de, title: navê pêşkêşvanê binivîse. Rêza duyem karê wê ye.

column1: Spelling counts. The audience reads it at the speed of light.
column2: Rastnivîs girîng e. Temaşevan bi leza ronahiyê dixwînin.

column1: Spell it right. Last week it said 'Jane O'Meal'.
column2: Rast binivîse. Hefteya borî 'June O'Nêl' dinivîsî.

column1: TAKE the Lower Third. Her name slides in over the map.
column2: Lower Third TAKE bike. Navê wê li ser nexşeyê dişemite.

column1: Two layers live: the weather, and the words on top of it.
column2: Du layer li çapê: hewa, û peyv li ser wê.

column1: Thank you. Now, about that lizard...
SOURCE, then Text: a title card. Then its backdrop chip: key green, for the vision mixer to key out.
column2: ÇAVKANÎ, paşê Text: kartek sernavê. Paşê çîpa paşxaneyê: kesk a key, da ku mixer wê derxe.

column1: A backdrop fills behind the words. Key green or key blue, and the mixer does the rest.
column2: Paşxane pişt peyvan tije dike. Kesk an şîn a key, mixer yên din dike.

column1: Breaking news: it's standing on the five-day forecast.
column2: Lezgîn: ew li ser pêşbîniya pênc rojan sekiniye.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio, skapi.
column2: Lower Third, nav, kartek sernavê, paşxane. Marmarok ji stûdyoyê derket, skapi.

column1: Lower Thirds can wait, slide and leave on their own. Their section has every setting.
column2: Lower Third dikarin bi xwe li bendê bin, bişemitin û derkevin. Beşa wan her mîheng heye.

column1: That's the weather. Back to you, guys. Run.
column2: Ev hewa bû. Em vedigerin stûdyoyê. Birevin.

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, and an inventor who wants cheese. Press START.
column2: Roketek ku di bodrumê de hatiye çêkirin, skapi, û dahênerek ku penîr dixwaze. START bitikîne.

column1: Stage timers: countdowns, clocks, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Demjimêrên sehnê: jimartina paşve, saet, û dîmena pêşkêşvan.

column1: Cheese, Grommet! The moon's made of it. We'll need a countdown.
column2: Penîr, Grommet! Heyv ji penîr e. Jimartineke paşve pêwîst e.

column1: SOURCE, then Stage Timer. A clock that counts down, in big friendly numbers.
column2: ÇAVKANÎ, paşê Stage Timer. Saetek ku paşve dijmêre, bi hejmarên mezin û dostane.

column1: Its colours change as it runs out: white, amber, red. Like a VU meter for time.
column2: Reng diguherin dema dem diqede: spî, kehrebayî, sor. Wek VU metreyeke demê.

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. The countdown starts.
column2: Demjimêrê hilbijêre û TAKE bike. Jimartin dest pê dike.

column1: Past zero it keeps going, counting the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Piştî sifirê dewam dike, dema zêde dijmêre. Pir rast. Hinekî bêedeb.

column1: Ten... nine... ooh, I do love a countdown.
column2: Deh... neh... oh, ez ji jimartina paşve hez dikim.

column1: Something's loose! Space holds the countdown. The clock shows it is held.
column2: Tiştek sist e! Space jimartinê radiwestîne. Saet nîşan dide ku rawestandî ye.

column1: A hold is not a stop. Space again, and it carries on from where it was.
column2: Rawestandin ne qedandin e. Dîsa Space, û ji cihê xwe dewam dike.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs: make an output's type PRESENTER. The person on stage gets the timer, the next cue and their notes.
column2: MENÛ, Video Outputs: cureyê outputekê bike PRESENTER. Kesê li ser sehnê demjimêr, cue-ya din û notên xwe dibîne.

column1: A presenter view is an output like any other. Point it at the confidence monitor.
column2: Dîmena pêşkêşvan outputek e wek yên din. Wê ber bi monitora sehnê ve bike.

column1: So the pilot can see the time. The pilot is Grommet.
column2: Da ku pîlot demê bibîne. Pîlot Grommet e.

column1: A countdown, a hold, and a view for the pilot. Nazdrave, skapi. Bring crackers.
column2: Jimartinek, rawestandinek, û dîmenek ji bo pîlot. Nazdrave, skapi. Biskuwît bîne.

column1: Timers can also count up, or show the time of day. Their section has the lot.
column2: Demjimêr dikarin ber bi jor jî bijmêrin, an demê nîşan bidin. Beşa wan her tişt heye.

column1: A grand day out, Grommet! Pass the crackers.
column2: Rojeke mezin, Grommet! Biskuwîtan bide min.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a prop, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Şanoyeke sêrbaziyê, skapi. Sindoqek, prop, û lêdanek ku her tişt bi hev re diguhere. START bitikîne.

column1: Two playlists are two layers. TAKE ALL changes both together.
column2: Du playlist du layer in. TAKE ALL herduyan bi hev re diguherîne.

column1: Every trick needs two things happening at once. And a rubber chicken.
column2: Her fêl hewceyî du tiştên ku bi hev re diqewimin e. Û mirîşkeke lastîkî.

column1: The prop goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Prop li ser layer-a xwe diçe. + li dawiya tabên playlistan bitikîne.

column1: Playlist 2 sits on top of playlist 1. Like a transparency on an overhead projector.
column2: Playlist 2 li ser playlist 1 rûdine. Wek transparentekê li ser projektora jorîn.

column1: Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my trunk.
column2: Di milê min de tiştek tune. Her tişt di sindoqa min de.

column1: In the new playlist, add anything: PATTERN will do. That is the prop.
column2: Di playlista nû de, her tiştî zêde bike: PATTERN baş e. Ew prop e.

column1: Whatever it is, it will appear the instant the trunk opens.
column2: Çi dibe bila bibe, dema sindoq vebe xuya dibe.

column1: Is it a rubber chicken? It's always a rubber chicken.
column2: Mirîşkeke lastîkî ye? Her tim mirîşkeke lastîkî ye.

column1: Select 'The trunk (open)' in playlist 1 and the prop in playlist 2. Then TAKE ALL: both on one beat.
column2: 'Sindoq (vekirî)' di playlist 1 de û prop di playlist 2 de hilbijêre. Paşê TAKE ALL: herdu di lêdanekê de.

column1: One press, every playlist's selected cue. The audience never sees the seam.
column2: Tikandinek, cue-ya hilbijartî ya her playlistê. Temaşevan qet dirûvê nabînin.
Ta-daaa! ...Li benda çepikan bin. Li bendê. Li bendê.

column1: Two layers, one beat. Every playlist has its own opacity and can sit on any output. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Du layer, lêdanek. Her playlist opacity-ya xwe heye û dikare li ser her outputê rûne. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A magician never reveals. A playlist never minds being revealed.
column2: Sêrbaz qet eşkere nake. Playlist ji eşkerebûnê aciz nabe.

column1: Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Spas! Ez hemû hefteyê li vir im! Mirîşk her tim li vir e.

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. Everything is on fire. Press START.
column2: Şanoyeke xwarinçêkirinê, skapi. Zindî. Her tişt dişewite. START bitikîne.

column1: BLACK hides the picture and keeps the show running. PANIC stops everything. Know which you need.
column2: BLACK wêneyê vedişêre û şanoyê dimeşîne. PANIC her tiştî radiwestîne. Bizane kîjan pêwîst e.

column1: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, de kitchen is fire-a-flurdy!
The audience must not see this. Press BLACK, or B.
column2: Temaşevan nabe vê bibînin. BLACK bitikîne, an jî B.

column1: The picture goes. The cue keeps playing underneath, ready to come back.
column2: Wêne diçe. Cue li jêr dilîze, amade ye vegere.

column1: Bork? Bork. Oh, de picture is gun.
The fire's out. Press B again: the picture comes back, still running.
column2: Agir vemirî. Dîsa B bitikîne: wêne vedigere, hîn dimeşe.

column1: Nothing was lost. A mute on a mixer, for pictures.
column2: Tiştek winda nebû. Mute li ser mixer, ji bo wêneyan.

column1: Worse: MENU, System, the SAFETY card: PANIC. Everything stops, the way the panic setting says.
column2: Xirabtir: MENÛ, Pergal, karta SAFETY: PANIC. Her tişt radiweste, wek ku mîhenga panîkê dibêje.

column1: PANIC is the big red button. Use it when BLACK is not enough. Then breathe.
column2: PANIC bişkoka sor a mezin e. Dema BLACK têr nake bi kar bîne. Paşê bêhn bigire.

column1: Close MENU, select the souffle, and TAKE it. The show is back on.
column2: MENÛ bigire, soufflé hilbijêre û TAKE bike. Şano vedigere.

column1: After a panic, the show is still there. Pick up where you meant to be.
column2: Piştî panîkê, şano hîn li wir e. Ji cihê ku te dixwest dewam bike.

column1: Voila! De souffle, he is risen!
BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen, skapi.
column2: BLACK ji bo veşartinê, PANIC ji bo rawestandinê, TAKE ji bo vegerê. Tu dê ji her metbexê xelas bibî, skapi.

column1: The panic setting chooses what PANIC does: fade out, cut, or just the outputs.
column2: Mîhenga panîkê hildibijêre ka PANIC çi dike: fade out, birrîn, an tenê output.

column1: Presets, skapi. A whole look, remembered, and back with one button. Press START.
column2: Preset, skapi. Xuyangek tevahî, bîranîn, û bi bişkokekê vedigere. START bitikîne.

column1: Like the patch memory on a synth: store, then recall.
column2: Wek bîra patch li ser synth: tomar bike, paşê bang bike.

column1: Press DASH: buttons of your own, for anything at all.
column2: DASH bitikîne: bişkokên te bi xwe, ji bo her tiştî.

column1: Ctrl+D also works. Very fast. Very professional.
column2: Ctrl+D jî dixebite. Pir bilez. Pir profesyonel.

column1: Press +, then 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. The button remembers this look.
column2: + bitikîne, paşê 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. Bişkok vê xuyangê bîr tîne.

column1: Store. Like saving the patch before the drummer leans on the synth.
column2: Tomar bike. Wek tomarkirina patch berî ku defçî xwe bispêre synth.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it. A different look.
column2: DASH bigire (Esc), paşê Xuyang du hilbijêre û TAKE bike. Xuyangeke din.

column1: Change it all. Don't worry. It remembers.
column2: Her tiştî biguherîne. Xem nexwe. Bîr tîne.

column1: Open the DASH and press your preset button. The first look comes back.
column2: DASH veke û bişkoka xwe ya preset bitikîne. Xuyanga yekem vedigere.

column1: Recall. The patch memory, returning. Beautiful.
column2: Bang kirin. Bîra patch vedigere. Xweş.

column1: A look, stored and recalled. A preset can keep cues, positions, effects, levels and routing; its button's menu chooses which.
column2: Xuyangek, tomarkirî û vegerandî. Preset dikare cue, cih, efekt, ast û rêvekirinê biparêze; menuya bişkoka wê hildibijêre kîjan.

column1: And a DASH button can run any command at all. Any. Even the exciting ones.
column2: Û bişkokeke DASH dikare her fermanê bimeşîne. Her yek. Yên heyecan jî.

column1: A space-opera trailer, skapi. A narrator with a very deep voice and opinions about transitions. Press START.
column2: Trailera operaya fezayê, skapi. Vebêjerek wek dengbêjekî, bi dengekî pir kûr û ramanên li ser transition. START bitikîne.

column1: A transition is how one cue becomes the next. There are far more than the crossfade.
column2: Transition ew e ku cue-yek çawa dibe ya din. Ji crossfade gelek zêdetir hene.

column1: In a galaxy of content... one operator... must choose a transition.
column2: Di galaksiyeke naverokê de... operatorek... divê transitionekê hilbijêre.

column1: 'The planet' is selected. In the inspector, its transition style: choose iris.
column2: 'Gerstêrk' hilbijartî ye. Di inspector de şêwaza transitiona wê: iris hilbijêre.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white. Even a portal. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Push, wipe, iris, dip to white. Heta portalek jî. Nîvê wan min nivîsî. Roja Sêşemê.

column1: The planet deserves... a dramatic entrance.
Give it a time: + on transition until it says a second or more.
column2: Demekê bide: li ser transition + heta ku saniyeyek an zêdetir bibêje.

column1: No time, no transition. A style needs a duration to do anything at all.
column2: Bê dem, bê transition. Şêwaz ji bo kirina tiştekî dem dixwaze.

column1: TAKE the planet. Watch it arrive.
column2: Gerstêrkê TAKE bike. Temaşe bike ku tê.

column1: The transition belongs to the cue arriving. Each cue chooses its own entrance.
column2: Transition ya cue-ya ku tê ye. Her cue ketina xwe hildibijêre.

column1: Now 'The battle': choose shatter, give it a time, and TAKE it.
column2: Niha 'Şer': shatter hilbijêre, demekê bide, û TAKE bike.

column1: Shatter drops the old picture like a pane of glass. Please do not do this at a funeral.
column2: Shatter wêneyê kevn wek camê davêje. Ji kerema xwe vê li şînê nekin.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Şêwazek, demek, û du ketinên pir dramatîk. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A playlist has a default style too, for every cue that does not choose its own.
column2: Playlistek jî şêwazeke standard heye, ji bo her cue-ya ku ya xwe hilnabijêre.

column1: Coming soon... to a desk near you.
column2: Di demeke nêz de... li ser maseyeke nêzî te.

column1: Two robot DJs, skapi. They do not talk. Their helmets do. Press START.
column2: Du DJ-yên robot, skapi. Ew naaxivin. Kumên wan diaxivin. START bitikîne.

column1: Every cue has its own chain of audio effects, and some of them break the sound on purpose.
column2: Her cue zincîra xwe ya efektên deng heye, û hin ji wan bi qestî dengê dişikînin.

column1: > HELLO. WE ARE HERE TO FIX YOUR MIX.
column2: > SILAV. EM HATIN MIXA TE ÇÊKIN.

column1: The beat is selected. In its AUDIO EFFECTS section, + adds one. Try the delay.
column2: Rîtm hilbijartî ye. Di beşa AUDIO EFFECTS de, + yekê zêde dike. Delay biceribîne.

column1: Delay, reverb, filters, a compressor. Amount always means 'less of this'.
column2: Delay, reverb, filter, compressor. Amount her tim tê wateya 'kêmtir ji vê'.

column1: > ONE MORE TIME. WITH ECHO. ECHO. ECHO.
column2: > CAREKE DIN. BI OLAN. OLAN. OLAN.

column1: Add a second: a bend, like crush. It damages the sound the way a broken file would.
column2: Ya duyem zêde bike: bendek, wek crush. Dengê wek pelekî şikestî xera dike.

column1: The bends are my favourite. Like a tape left in the sun. On purpose.
column2: Bend yên min ên herî hezkirî ne. Wek kasetekê ku di tavê de ma. Bi qestî.

column1: MENU, then Audio: where each playlist's sound goes, and the patch for named outputs.
column2: MENÛ, paşê Deng: dengê her playlistê diçe ku, û patch ji bo outputên navdar.

column1: Speakers, monitors, an in-ear for the drummer. The patch sends each its own.
column2: Hoparlor, monitor, in-ear ji bo defçî. Patch ji her yekê ya wî dişîne.

column1: > AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX.
column2: > LI DORA MIXÊ. LI DORA MIXÊ. LI DORA MIXÊ.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, skapi. I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Efektek, bendek û patch. Robot dipejirînin, skapi. Ez difikirim. Rûyên wan kum in.

column1: Every audio effect can follow a ~ too, even Motion. Wave at the delay. It's wonderful.
column2: Her efekta deng dikare li pey ~ jî here, heta Motion. Destê xwe ji delay re bihejîne. Ecêb e.

column1: > THANK YOU. GOOD NIGHT. WE ARE ROBOTS.
column2: > SPAS. ŞEV BAŞ. EM ROBOT IN.

column1: The Bureau again, skapi. A glow on the horizon, and two agents who disagree about it. Press START.
column2: Dîsa Buro, skapi. Ronahiyek li ser asoyê, û du ajan ku li ser li hev nakin. START bitikîne.

column1: The scopes measure a picture: brightness, colour, levels. Numbers, not opinions.
column2: Scope wêneyê dipîvin: geşî, reng, ast. Hejmar, ne raman.

column1: It's them, Brandt. It's a craft. Look how it glows.
column2: Ew in, Brandt. Keştî ye. Binêre çawa dibiriqe.

column1: The scopes read only what really goes out, never a preview. Turn the output on: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.
column2: Scope tenê tiştê ku bi rastî derdikeve dixwînin, qet preview na. Outputê veke: MENÛ, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.

column1: Measuring a scaled-down preview would be measuring a photocopy. We measure the original.
column2: Pîvana previewekî biçûkkirî wek pîvana fotokopiyê ye. Em orîjînalê dipîvin.

column1: Chain of evidence, Hollis. The real signal or nothing.
column2: Zincîra delîlan, Hollis. Sînyala rastîn an tiştek na.

column1: Close MENU. Above the monitor, the PROGRAM button: press it until it says SCOPES or BOTH.
column2: MENÛ bigire. Li jor monitorê, bişkoka PROGRAM: heta SCOPES an BOTH bibêje bitikîne.

column1: Both shows the picture and its scopes side by side. Very civilised.
column2: BOTH wêne û scope-yên wê li kêleka hev nîşan dide. Pir şaristanî.

column1: Click the waveform to make it big. Bright things sit high, dark things low, left to right as in the picture.
column2: Li waveform bitikîne da ku mezin bibe. Tiştên geş li jor, yên tarî li jêr, ji çepê ber bi rastê wek di wêneyê de.

column1: The glow is that spike near the top. Very bright. Bright is not the same as alien.
column2: Ronî ew lûtke ye nêzî jor. Pir geş. Geş ne wek biyanî ye.

column1: Look at the peak. Nothing a streetlight couldn't do.
column2: Li lûtkeyê binêre. Tiştek ku lampeya kolanê nekaribe bike tune.

column1: Click it again to go back, then click the vectorscope: colour round a circle. Saturated runs to the edge.
column2: Dîsa bitikîne da ku vegerî, paşê li vectorscope bitikîne: reng li dora bazineyê. Têr ber bi kêlekê ve direve.

column1: Magenta, far out by the rim. A strong colour. Strong is not illegal. Yet.
column2: Magenta, dûr li kêlekê. Rengekî xurt. Xurt ne neqanûnî ye. Hîn.

column1: It's off the chart, Brandt! Literally off the chart!
column2: Ji grafîkê derket, Brandt! Bi rastî!

column1: And false colour: red is clipped, yellow nearly. Is the glow red?
column2: Û rengê derewîn: sor birrî ye, zer hema hema. Ronî sor e?

column1: Clipped means the brightest the signal can carry, and then some lost. Detail gone.
column2: Birrî tê wateya geşiya herî zêde ku sînyal dikare hilgire, û hinek li jor winda bûye. Hûrgilî çûn.

column1: Red. Clipped. Not alien, Hollis. Just too bright. Case closed.
column2: Sor. Birrî. Ne biyanî, Hollis. Tenê pir geş. Doz girtî.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it, skapi. The agents did not.
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, rengê derewîn. Scope biryar dan, skapi. Ajanan na.

column1: SCOPES SOURCE reads any output, and the matrix can be 709 or 2020. For the curious.
column2: SCOPES SOURCE her outputê dixwîne, û matrix dikare 709 an 2020 be. Ji bo meraqdaran.

column1: Too bright for a streetlight, Brandt. Too bright for anything. ...I want to believe.
column2: Ji bo lampeya kolanê pir geş, Brandt. Ji bo her tiştî pir geş. ...Ez dixwazim bawer bikim.

column1: Pictures that leave by cable or network, skapi, not only a window on a screen. Press START.
column2: Wêneyên ku bi kablo an torê derdikevin, skapi, ne tenê pencereyek li ser ekranê. START bitikîne.

column1: NDI over the network, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: NDI li ser torê, SDI ji karta DeckLink, ST 2110 ji bo navendên weşanê.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs, then Devices: every way an output can leave this computer.
column2: MENÛ, Video Outputs, paşê Amûr: her rêya ku output dikare ji vê komputerê derkeve.

column1: Each one says whether this machine can do it, and what it needs if not.
column2: Her yek dibêje ka ev makîne dikare an na, û eger na çi pêwîst e.

column1: If this computer has NDI, switch NDI SENDING on: the picture is on the network. If not, SHOW ME moves on.
column2: Eger NDI li vê komputerê hebe, NDI SENDING veke: wêne li ser torê ye. Eger na, SHOW ME dewam dike.

column1: NDI finds itself on the network. No cables, only a good switch and patience.
column2: NDI xwe li ser torê dibîne. Bê kablo, tenê switcheke baş û sebir.

column1: The output's own page has the rest: a DeckLink card's SDI, ST 2110 with NMOS, Spout and Syphon.
column2: Rûpela outputê bi xwe yên din heye: SDI ya karta DeckLink, ST 2110 bi NMOS, Spout û Syphon.

column1: Every one is just an output. The show does not know or care how it leaves.
column2: Her yek tenê outputek e. Şano nizane û ne xema wê ye ka çawa derdikeve.

column1: The bridge of the starship Cathode, skapi. Four feeds, one main viewer, one mystery. Press START.
column2: Pira keştiya fezayê Cathode, skapi. Çar feed, ekraneke sereke, razek. START bitikîne.

column1: The multiview shows every playlist at once. Like a wall of oscilloscopes, but in space.
column2: Multiview hemû playlistan bi hev re nîşan dide. Wek dîwarekî ji oscilloscopan, lê di fezayê de.

column1: Frequencies open, Captain. All of them. That's the problem.
column2: Frekans vekirî ne, kaptan. Hemû. Pirsgirêk ev e.

column1: MULTI, above the monitor: every playlist in its own window.
column2: MULTI, li jor monitorê: her playlist di pencereya xwe de.

column1: One window per playlist, the programme first.
column2: Pencereyek ji bo her playlistê, bername pêşî.

column1: Jinkys! Four feeds. And one of them has a monster in it.
column2: Jinkys! Çar feed. Û di yekê de cinawirek heye.

column1: Add a window (+), then its ... menu: make it show NEXT. What goes live when you press TAKE.
column2: Pencereyekê zêde bike (+), paşê menuya wê ...: NEXT nîşan bide. Çi diçe çapê dema tu TAKE bitikînî.

column1: Every window has a ... button. It chooses what that window shows.
column2: Her pencere bişkokeke ... heye. Hildibijêre ka ew pencere çi nîşan dide.

column1: I need to see who's calling before they reach the main viewer.
column2: Divê ez bibînim kî bang dike berî ku bigihe ekrana sereke.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late. Mostly.
column2: Û pencereyeke din, ku saetê nîşan dide. Operatorên ku li saetê dinêrin qet dereng namînin. Bi piranî.

column1: Time of day, big. Stardates are just very long timecode.
column2: Dema rojê, mezin. Stardate tenê timecodeke pir dirêj e.

column1: The monster only shows up at midnight. We're going to need a clock.
column2: Cinawir tenê nîvê şevê xuya dibe. Saetek pêwîst e.

column1: Any window's ... menu, then a layout: one big, the rest small.
column2: Menuya ... ya her pencereyê, paşê layout: yek mezin, yên din biçûk.

column1: The big window is window one. Usually the programme. Usually.
column2: Pencereya mezin pencereya yek e. Bi gelemperî bername. Bi gelemperî.

column1: Main viewer big. The captain likes it big.
column2: Ekrana sereke mezin. Kaptan ji mezin hez dike.

column1: Select Deck 3 in playlist 3 and TAKE. Watch its window.
column2: Qat 3 di playlist 3 de hilbijêre û TAKE bike. Li pencereya wê binêre.

column1: The red border is TALLY: the window that is on air. On screen, as they say on starships.
column2: Çarçoveya sor TALLY ye: pencereya ku li çapê ye. Li ser ekranê, wek ku li keştiyan dibêjin.

column1: There! Feed three! Put it on screen!
column2: Li wir! Feed sê! Bide ser ekranê!

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved, skapi.
column2: Pencere, menuya ..., NEXT, saet, layout, tally. Raz hate çareserkirin, skapi.

column1: A window can also show an output, with its warp and slices. Handy when it's a lighthouse.
column2: Pencere dikare outputekê jî nîşan bide, bi warp û slice-yên wê. Bi kêr e dema fener be.

column1: And the monster was... the ship's cook, all along. Jinkys.
column2: Û cinawir... aşpêjê keştiyê bû, her tim. Jinkys.

column1: finish or leave the lesson you are in first
column2: pêşî dersa ku tu tê de yî biqedîne an jê derkeve

column1: Psst. It's me, the desk. I'll be watching. Supportively.
column2: Pist. Ez im, mase. Ez ê temaşe bikim. Bi piştgirî.

column1: Hi! I'm the one doing all of this, by the way.
column2: Silav! Bi rastî, ez her tiştî dikim.

column1: Ctrl+D opens the DASH. I'm just saying.
Nearly there. I can feel it in my pixels.
column2: Hema hema. Di pîkselên xwe de hîs dikim.

column1: You're good at this. I can tell. I'm the one doing it.
column2: Tu di vê de baş î. Dibînim. Ez dikim.

column1: Every click, I heard. Every single one.
column2: Her tikandin, min bihîst. Her yek.

column1: The glowing one. I can see it from here. It's glowing for you.
column2: Ya ku dibiriqe. Ji vir dibînim. Ji bo te dibiriqe.

column2: ders rawestî - MENÛ > LESSONS ji cihê ku te hişt dewam dike

column1: PROF. VIDEO:  The signal: what the picture is made of, and how to bend it. Pick a lesson.
column2: PROF. VIDEO:  Sînyal: wêne ji çi hatiye çêkirin, û çawa tê xwarkirin. Dersekê hilbijêre.

column1: DR. PIXEL:  Running the show, skapi. Fast hands, calm face. Pick a lesson.
column2: DR. PIXEL:  Meşandina şanoyê, skapi. Destên bilez, rûyê aram. Dersekê hilbijêre.

column2: pêşî LEARN THE BASICS biqedîne an jê derkeve

column1: bug swat: Esc leaves, and your show comes back as it was
column2: bug swat: Esc derdikeve, û şanoya te wek berê vedigere

column1: bug swat: your show is back. Motion's controls are in Settings > Audio
column2: bug swat: şanoya te vegeriya. Kontrolên Motion di Mîheng > Deng de ne

column1: Bugs are crawling to the cue list! Swat them by waving at your camera. First, Motion: in MOTION CONTROL turn it ON and choose what it READS.
column2: Kêzik ber bi lîsteya cue ve dikişin! Bi destê xwe ji kamerayê re bihejîne û wan biperçiqîne. Pêşî Motion: di MOTION CONTROL de ON bike û hilbijêre ka çi dixwîne (READS).

column1: This one is NullPointer. Hollow, points at nothing. A finger goes straight through. Use the whole hand, skapi.
column2: Ev NullPointer e. Vala ye, nîşanî tiştekî nade. Tilî di nav re derbas dibe. Hemû destê xwe bi kar bîne, skapi.

column1: Wave like you are hailing a cab! A small, polite cab. Not the buttons. The cab.
column2: Wek ku taksiyekê rawestînî destê xwe bihejîne! Taksiyeke biçûk û bi edeb. Ne bişkok. Taksî.

column1: Race Condition: twins, each sure it got there first. One reading cannot tell your hands apart, so drag two ZONES on the Motion picture, one each side.
column2: Race Condition: cêwî, her yek bawer e ku pêşî gihîştiye. Xwendinek nikare destên te ji hev cuda bike, ji ber vê du ZONES li ser wêneyê Motion bikişîne, yek li her aliyekî.

column1: Hit both together. Hit one, and they swap. Like my cousins at a wedding.
column2: Herduyan bi hev re lê bide. Yekê lê bide, cih diguherin. Wek pismamên min li dawetê.

column1: One hand each side. Together! Together!
column2: Destek li her aliyekî. Bi hev re! Bi hev re!

column1: Off By One. The bug is not the face, it is the tiny extra segment, and a little wiggle needs a finer reading. Turn SENSITIVITY down to 5%.
column2: Off By One. Kêzik ne rû ye, perçeyê biçûk ê zêde ye, û tevgereke biçûk xwendineke hûrtir dixwaze. SENSITIVITY daxîne 5%.

column1: Lower number, finer reading. Yes, I also think it is backwards.
column2: Hejmara nizmtir, xwendina hûrtir. Erê, ez jî difikirim ku berevajî ye.

column1: Not the face. The little one on the end. Wiggle a finger.
column2: Ne rû. Ya biçûk li dawiyê. Tiliyekê bilivîne.

column1: Memory Leak. It only lets go while the reading stays up. Make FALL longer, 1.5 seconds or more, so your sweeps join up into one.
column2: Memory Leak. Tenê dema xwendin bilind dimîne berdide. FALL dirêjtir bike, 1.5 saniye an zêdetir, da ku lêdanên te bibin yek.

column1: Slow and steady, skapi. Like paying back a loan.
column2: Hêdî û domdar, skapi. Wek dayîna deynekî.

column1: Sweep, and sweep again. Let the fall carry you between.
column2: Bimale, û dîsa bimale. Bila daketin te di navberê de hilgire.

column1: The Heisenbug! It fades whenever you move. Put a tone cue's pitch on Motion X and follow it by ear: the ticking speeds up as you close in.
column2: Heisenbug! Her gava ku tu diliviyî kal dibe. Bilindahiya cue-ya dengekî deyne ser Motion X û bi guh bişopîne: dema nêzîk dibî tik-tik bilez dibe.

column1: SHOW ME makes the tone for you. High is right. Low is left. Stand still and it comes back.
column2: SHOW ME dengê ji te re çêdike. Bilind rast e. Nizm çep e. Bisekine û vedigere.

column1: Follow it. Listen. Faster ticking, closer bug.
column2: Bişopîne. Guhdarî bike. Tik-tika bileztir, kêzika nêztir.

column1: Closed as fixed. No regressions. Probably.
column2: Wek çêkirî hate girtin. Bê paşveçûn. Belkî.

column1: One reached the cue list. It has filed a bug report about you.
column2: Yek gihîşt lîsteya cue. Raporeke çewtiyê li ser te tomar kir.

column1: Skapi. It is a handheld. You do not press it. You wave at it.
column2: Skapi. Ev amûreke destan e. Tu wê natikînî. Tu destê xwe jê re dihejînî.

column1: The buttons are for menus. The bugs are for flailing.
column2: Bişkok ji bo menuyan in. Kêzik ji bo hejandina milan in.

column1: The D-pad is decorative. Like my diploma.
column2: D-pad xemilandin e. Wek dîploma min.

column1: In 1989 we also pressed the buttons. Then we discovered waving. Never looked back.
column2: Di 1989-an de me jî bişkok ditikandin. Paşê me hejandin dît. Me qet li paş nenêrî.

column1: Pressing harder does not help. The bugs cannot feel buttons. Only arms.
column2: Bi hêztir tikandin alîkarî nake. Kêzik bişkokan hîs nakin. Tenê milan.

column1: It's called a handheld because your hands are held... up. In the air. Waving.
column2: Jê re amûra destan dibêjin ji ber ku dest... bilind dibin. Li hewayê. Dihejin.

column1: The mouse? You are swatting bugs with a MOUSE? In Bulgaria the mouse would be on the bugs' side.
column2: Mişk? Tu bi MIŞKÊ kêzikan diperçiqînî? Li Bulgaristanê mişk dê li aliyê kêzikan be.

column2: Tikandinên xweş. Pir hişk. Kamerayê yek jî nedît.
