column1: LED panel width in pixels - what one tile really is. Click to type it
column2: Firehiya panela LED bi pîkselan - kaşiyek bi rastî çi ye. Bitikîne ji bo nivîsandinê

column1: Which deck it acts on; step off the end for the one this cue lives on
column2: Li ser kîjan deck dixebite; ji dawiyê derbas bibe ji bo deck a vê cue

column1: only one playlist - use the routing chip on the header to add another
column2: tenê yek lîste - çîpa rêkirinê ya li serî bi kar bîne ji bo zêdekirina yeke din

column1: Which cue this master fires on that deck; step off the end to clear it
column2: Ev master li ser wî deck kîjan cue dide destpêkirin; ji dawiyê derbas bibe ji bo paqijkirinê

column1: Choose a mask from this show's library, or start a new one from a shape
column2: Ji pirtûkxaneya vê nîşanê maskekê hilbijêre, an ji şikilekî yeke nû dest pê bike

column1: Draw on the programme monitor with the mouse or a pen (DRAW). Esc stops
column2: Li ser çavdêrê bernameyê bi mişk an pênûsê xêz bike (DRAW). Esc radiwestîne

column1: Going on air takes the cue. Deckboy never sends the switcher a command.
column2: Ketina weşanê cue digire. Deckboy qet fermanê naşîne guhêrbarê.

column1: How long the move takes, each way. 0 is instant whatever the style says
column2: Tevger çiqas dem digire, her alî. 0 yekser e çi şêwe dibe bila bibe

column1: Stop that deck when the ramp lands - the usual take-it-down-and-stop-it
column2: Dema rampa digihîje wî deck rawestîne - kêmkirin-û-rawestandina asayî

column1: Which of the file's sound tracks plays: a second language, a commentary
column2: Kîjan rêya dengê ya pelê lê dide: zimanê duyem, şîrove

column1: An oscillator on the colour: depth is how far round the wheel it travels
column2: Osîlatorek li ser rengê: kûrahî ew e ka çiqas li dora çerxê digere

column1: Rack this cue paused and off air so GO starts it with no decoder spin-up
column2: Vê cue rawestiyayî û derveyî weşanê amade bike da ku GO bê derengiya dekoderê dest pê bike

column1: Note, control change, program change, MIDI Show Control, or your own bytes
column2: Nota, control change, program change, MIDI Show Control, an baytên te

column1: Black behind the words. Zero leaves it over whatever the output already has
column2: Reş li pişt peyvan. Sifir wan li ser tiştê ku derketinê heye dihêle

column1: How far the modulator bends the pitch. 0-63, the hardware's own gain range.
column2: Modulator pîçê çiqas xwar dike. 0-63, rêza zêdekirinê ya hardware.

column1: the words this cue puts on screen  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: peyvên ku ev cue li ekranê datîne  |  Shift+Enter: rêza nû  |  Enter: bicîh bîne

column1: OSC and UDP are fire and forget; TCP connects, so it runs off the show thread
column2: OSC û UDP dişînin û ji bîr dikin; TCP girê dide, ji ber vê li derveyî xeta nîşanê dimeşe

column1: Put the level on an oscillator: Motion makes it a gate that opens as you move
column2: Astê li ser osîlatorekê deyne: Motion wê dike deriyek ku dema tu dilivî vedibe

column1: Marks stacked ABOVE the characters, the way combining accents overflow a line.
column2: Nîşan li SER tîpan kom bûne, wekî nîşanên hevgirtî yên ku ji rêzê derdikevin.

column1: Save the mask as a greyscale PNG at the output's size: white keeps, black cuts
column2: Maskê wekî PNG ya gewr bi mezinahiya derketinê tomar bike: spî digire, reş dibire

column1: Which chime. Cycling PLAYS it, so it can be chosen by ear rather than by name.
column2: Kîjan zengil. Guhertin wê LÊ DIXE, da ku bi guh were hilbijartin ne bi navê.

column1: No rows. + ADD or LEARN makes one; MIDIMAP RESET brings the built-in rows back.
column2: Rêz tune. + ADD an LEARN yekê çêdike; MIDIMAP RESET rêzên bingehîn vedigerîne.

column1: Save the mask's paths as SVG, for Illustrator and anything else that reads them
column2: Rêyên maskê wekî SVG tomar bike, ji bo Illustrator û her tiştê ku wan dixwîne

column1: Which MIDI output; a named port that is missing is reported rather than swapped
column2: Kîjan derketina MIDI; portek bi nav ku tune ye tê ragihandin, nayê guhertin

column1: An oscillator on the level, running after GO until a later cue sets this fixture
column2: Osîlatorek li ser astê, piştî GO dimeşe heta cue yeke paşê vê ronahiyê saz bike

column1: Steps in third-octaves, because the ear works in ratios. 1kHz is the convention.
column2: Gav bi sêyeka oktavê, ji ber ku guh bi rêjeyan dixebite. 1kHz adet e.

column1: Strikes drawn ACROSS the cell, damaging the character rather than decorating it.
column2: Xêzên DI NAV şaneyê re, tîpê xirab dikin li şûna xemilandinê.

column1: Whether incoming MIDI notes play this synth or trigger cues as they always have.
column2: Notayên MIDI yên tên vê synth lê dixin an wekî her car cue didin destpêkirin.

column1: A note number, or type LEARN and play it. Notes no cue claims still go to cue N+1
column2: Hejmara notayê, an LEARN binivîse û lê bixe. Notayên ku tu cue nagire hê diçin cue N+1

column1: A plain stereo pair. Click to open the matrix, starting from exactly this routing
column2: Cotek stereo ya sade. Bitikîne ji bo vekirina matrixê, rast ji vê rêkirinê

column1: Folding is what turns an arbitrary pattern into something that reads as designed.
column2: Pêçandin e ku şablonekî kêfî dike tiştek ku sêwirandî xuya dike.

column1: Channel=level, comma separated. Ranges too: 1=255, 10-14=64. Channels count from 1
column2: Kenal=ast, bi bêhnokê veqetandî. Rêze jî: 1=255, 10-14=64. Kenal ji 1 tên jimartin

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Trim a her cue ya hilbijartî bi heman dB dilivîne; nivîsandina nirxekê hemûyan li ser wê datîne

column1: Bends the carrier's PITCH rather than mixing with it. This is what makes FDS growl.
column2: PÎÇA hilgir xwar dike li şûna ku pê re têkel bibe. Ev e ku FDS dike ku bigire.

column1: Half way through LEARN THE BASICS. Press L and we pick up where you stopped, skapi.
column2: Nîvê rêya BINGEHAN HÎN BIBE. L bitikîne û em ji cihê ku tu lê rawestiyayî berdewam dikin, skapi.

column1: Render as a character grid with a 16-colour indexed palette, rather than as pixels.
column2: Wekî tora tîpan bi paleta 16 rengan render bike, ne wekî pîkselan.

column1: Which MIDI output this file plays to; step past the end for the first one available
column2: Ev pel li kîjan derketina MIDI lê dide; ji dawiyê derbas bibe ji bo ya yekem a amade

column1: An IPv4 address, or 255.255.255.255 for the universe's multicast group (239.255.x.y)
column2: Navnîşanek IPv4, an 255.255.255.255 ji bo koma multicast a universe (239.255.x.y)

column1: Click a cell to walk it: off, full, -3, -6, -12. This row turns the matrix off again
column2: Li şaneyekê bitikîne ji bo guhertinê: girtî, tije, -3, -6, -12. Ev rêz matrixê dîsa digire

column1: How long each phrase stays before it moves. Zero hides them without losing the list.
column2: Her hevok çiqas dimîne berî ku bilive. Sifir wan vedişêre bêyî windakirina lîsteyê.

column1: How long it takes to fall away after the attack. Only audible when retrigger is set.
column2: Piştî êrîşê çiqas dem digire ku dakeve. Tenê dema ku ji nû ve tetikkirin vekirî be tê bihîstin.

column1: Off, from start (next cue fires when this one starts) or from end (when it finishes)
column2: Girtî, ji destpêkê (cue ya din dema ev dest pê dike dest pê dike) an ji dawiyê (dema diqede)

column1: Height of one line as a percent of the raster, so a card reads the same on any screen
column2: Bilindahiya rêzekê wekî ji sedî ya raster, da ku kartek li ser her ekranê wekî hev were xwendin

column1: Set slot source as media:/path, browser:url, window:name, camera:name, or syphon:name
column2: Çavkaniya slotê wekî media:/rê, browser:url, window:nav, camera:nav, an syphon:nav bide

column1: Short LFSR mode. The period is brief enough to read as pitched metal rather than hiss.
column2: Moda LFSR ya kurt. Dewr têra xwe kurt e ku wekî metala bi pîç were bihîstin ne fîşîn.

column1: White, warm, red, amber, green, cyan, blue, magenta. ~ moves it round the colour wheel
column2: Spî, germ, sor, zer, kesk, şînê vekirî, şîn, magenta. ~ wê li dora çerxa rengan dilivîne

column1: Re-strike the envelope this often. Hold sustains one note, which is what a drone wants.
column2: Zerfê bi vî rengî dîsa lê bixe. Hold notayekê digire, tiştê ku drone dixwaze.

column1: Diamond is the hard-edged Atari Video Music lattice; rings tunnel well with feedback zoom.
column2: Diamond tora qerax-hişk a Atari Video Music e; xelek bi zoom a vegerê tunelekê baş çêdikin.

column1: Rock or spin. Depth 1 is half a turn either way; a saw at depth 1 turns it all the way round
column2: Bihejîne an bizivirîne. Kûrahiya 1 nîv zivirînek e her alî; saw li 1 bi tevahî dizivirîne

column1: DECK playback level (live, not saved with the cue) - per-cue trim is gain in the AUDIO section
column2: Asta lêxistina DECK (zindî, bi cue re nayê tomarkirin) - trim a her cue zêdekirin e di beşa AUDIO de

column1: Still, fade in, typewriter, scroll up, crawl or pulse -- all driven by the cue's own transport
column2: Sekinî, ketina hêdî, daktîlo, jor çûn, xişandin an lêdan -- hemû bi veguhastina cue bi xwe tên meşandin

column1: Fields per rendered frame. 1 is one for one, 0.5 holds each field for two frames, 0 freezes it.
column2: Zevî di her wêneyekî de. 1 yek bi yek e, 0.5 her zeviyê du wêneyan digire, 0 dicemidîne.

column1: What this cue shows while it plays: waveform, scope, Lissajous, spectrum, meters or a name card
column2: Ev cue dema lê dide çi nîşan dide: forma pêlê, scope, Lissajous, spektrum, pîvan an karta navê

column1: 0 picks tiles by brightness so the picture reads. 1 picks at random so the grid becomes texture.
column2: 0 kaşiyan li gor ronahiyê hildibijêre da ku wêne were xwendin. 1 bi rasthatinî hildibijêre da ku tor bibe tevn.

column1: How far it travels, in semitones. Up reads as arrival, down as departure, zero is a struck note.
column2: Çiqas diçe, bi nîv-tonan. Jor wekî gihîştin, jêr wekî çûyîn, sifir notayeke lêxistî ye.

column1: An IPv4 address. Names are not resolved: a DNS lookup is a blocking call and GO must not make one
column2: Navnîşanek IPv4. Nav nayên çareserkirin: lêgerîna DNS asteng dike û GO nabe yekê bike

column1: Tile width in pixels. Must match the sheet's grid or the slices land across neighbouring sprites.
column2: Firehiya kaşiyê bi pîkselan. Divê bi tora pelê re li hev were, an perçe dê bikevin ser sprite yên cîran.

column1: Alternating mirrors by cell position, which reads as pattern where random flipping reads as noise.
column2: Neynikên guhêrbar li gor cihê şaneyê, ku wekî şablon têne xwendin li cihê ku zivirandina rasthatinî wekî deng tê xwendin.

column1: 0 welds them to their cell, which reads as engraved. Above it they re-roll, which reads as boiling.
column2: 0 wan bi şaneya wan ve dizeliqîne, wekî kolandî. Li jor wê ji nû ve tên kişandin, wekî ku dikelin.

column1: MONO L plays the left input in both speakers: mic 1 on most interfaces. STEREO is for a line source.
column2: MONO L ketina çep di her du hoparlêran de lê dide: mîkrofona 1 li ser piraniya navrûyan. STEREO ji bo çavkaniya xetê ye.

column1: The whole gesture. This IS the cue's duration -- a sting is the one generated signal here that ends.
column2: Tevahiya tevgerê. Ev dirêjahiya cue YE -- sting tenê îşareta çêkirî ye li vir ku diqede.

column1: Click the value to send this fixture or leave it where the last cue put it. ~ makes the level breathe
column2: Li nirxê bitikîne ji bo şandina vê ronahiyê an hiştina wê li cihê ku cue ya dawî danî. ~ astê dike ku nefes bigire

column1: FDS is a wavetable bent by a modulator. 2A03 is the pulse/triangle/noise set most chiptune is made of.
column2: FDS tabloyeke pêlan e ku modulator xwar dike. 2A03 koma pulse/triangle/noise e ku piraniya chiptune jê hatiye çêkirin.

column1: Scramble which glyph means which brightness. Same set, different handwriting. Seeded, so it stays put.
column2: Tevlihev bike kîjan glyph kîjan ronahiyê dide. Heman kom, destnivîseke din. Bi tov, ji ber vê disekine.

column1: Pixel sort: runs of pixels sorted by brightness within a row, which is what makes datamosh look melted.
column2: Rêzkirina pîkselan: rêzên pîkselan li gor ronahiyê di nav rêzekê de, ya ku datamosh dike ku helandî xuya bike.

column1: How many cells the marks may climb. They thin out as they go, so a tall reach trails rather than doubles.
column2: Nîşan dikarin çend şaneyan hilkişin. Her ku diçin zirav dibin, ji ber vê gihîştina bilind şopê dihêle ne ducarî dibe.

column1: cue act val  -  G take  S stop  F fade out (val = tenths of a second)  V volume  O opacity  J jump to row
column2: cue kar nirx  -  G bigire  S rawestîne  F derketina hêdî (nirx = dehyeka çirkeyê)  V deng  O tarîtî  J here rêzê

column1: Harmonic weight: a pure chime at zero, brass at full. This is the difference between a ping and a fanfare.
column2: Giraniya harmonîk: zengileke paqij li sifirê, sifir li tijebûnê. Ev ferqa di navbera ping û fanfarê de ye.

column1: Steps through the inputs this computer has. 'Settings input' follows the input chosen in Settings > Audio.
column2: Di ketinên vê kompîterê re derbas dibe. 'Settings input' li pey ketina ku di Settings > Audio de hatiye hilbijartin diçe.

column1: Embers to roaring. It still surges and settles at any setting -- a fire that does not move reads as a photo
column2: Ji pelên agir heta agirê gurr. Di her mîhengê de rabe û danî -- agirê ku nalive wekî wêneyekê xuya dike

column1: Reference pitch. 440 is modern standard, 432 the common alternative, and older instruments sat lower still.
column2: Pîça referansê. 440 standarda nûjen e, 432 alternatîfa hevpar, û amûrên kevntir hê nizmtir bûn.

column1: Where the sting starts. Under a voice it wants to stay out of the way; over a room it wants to cut through.
column2: Sting li ku dest pê dike. Di bin dengekê de divê ji rê dûr bimîne; li ser odeyekê divê derbas bibe.

column1: Digital gain on the input, -40 to +40 dB. Set the interface's own preamp first; this is for the last few dB.
column2: Zêdekirina dîjîtal li ser ketinê, -40 heta +40 dB. Pêşî preamp a navrûyê saz bike; ev ji bo çend dB yên dawî ye.

column1: Pulse the size. On its own this moves width AND height together; give height its own ~ to squash and stretch
column2: Mezinahiyê lêdan bike. Bi tenê firehî Û bilindahiyê bi hev re dilivîne; ~ ya xwe bide bilindahiyê ji bo pelçiqandin û dirêjkirinê

column1: A card fills the frame; a Lower Third is a name and a role, low on a transparent frame, with an in and an out
column2: Kartek wêneyê tije dike; Lower Third nav û rolek e, li jêr li ser wêneyekî zelal, bi ketin û derketinê

column1: Held keeps the last displacement rather than removing it -- the picture stays bent the way the driver left it.
column2: Held guhertina dawî digire li şûna rakirinê -- wêne wekî ku ajoker hişt xwar dimîne.

column1: 12.5 and 25 are thin and reedy, 50 is hollow. 75 sounds identical to 25 -- it is here because trackers expose it.
column2: 12.5 û 25 zirav û pifî ne, 50 vala ye. 75 wekî 25 tê bihîstin -- li vir e ji ber ku tracker wê nîşan didin.

column1: Quantise the output like the hardware. The steps ARE the sound; smoothing them makes it a synth imitating a chip.
column2: Derketinê wekî hardware quantise bike. Gav DENG IN; nermkirina wan wê dike synth ku çîpekê teqlîd dike.

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB, keeping the differences between them; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Trim a her cue ya hilbijartî bi heman dB dilivîne, ferqên wan diparêze; nivîsandina nirxekê hemûyan li ser wê datîne

column1: Where the playlist's crosspoints send it (Settings > Audio). Click to open the matrix by name, starting from exactly that
column2: Xalên hevbirrînê yên lîsteyê wê li ku dişînin (Settings > Audio). Bitikîne ji bo vekirina matrixê bi navê, rast ji wê rêkirinê

column1: name values with  d = ...;  end with one expression, or three for red green blue  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: nirxan bi  d = ...;  binav bike, bi derbirînekê biqedîne, an sê ji bo sor kesk şîn  |  Shift+Enter: rêza nû  |  Enter: bicîh bîne

column1: Put back what it started from once the ramp lands (after the stop): a deck left ready for its next cue, a swell that lets go
column2: Dema rampa digihîje (piştî rawestanê) tiştê ku jê dest pê kiribû vegerîne: deck a amade ji bo cue ya xwe ya din, rabûneke ku berdide

column1: Which speech model makes the captions: English, any language, or the slower, more accurate pair. Each is a one-time download
column2: Kîjan modela axaftinê binnivîsan çêdike: Îngilîzî, her ziman, an cota hêdîtir û rasttir. Her yek carekê tê daxistin

column1: What the mask cuts: this cue wherever it plays, this playlist on the focused output, that output's whole picture, or its matte
column2: Mask çi dibire: ev cue li ku derê lê bide, ev lîste li ser derketina fokûskirî, tevahiya wêneyê wê derketinê, an matte ya wê

column1: Play at the screen's rate when it is within 0.2% (59.94 on 60): every frame shown once, the sound up to 3.5 cents sharp or flat
column2: Bi leza ekranê lê bide dema ku di nav 0.2% de be (59.94 li ser 60): her wêne carekê, deng heta 3.5 cent bilind an nizm

column1: Quarter turns are exact and stay crisp. Spinning samples at an angle, which tears pixel art -- sometimes that is what you want.
column2: Zivirînên çaryek rast in û zelal dimînin. Zivirîn bi goşeyekê nimûne digire, ku hunera pîkselan diçirîne -- carinan ev e ya ku tu dixwazî.

column1: Every take starts the puppetry the same way, so a rehearsed look repeats instead of depending on how long the app has been open.
column2: Her take tevgerê bi heman awayî dest pê dike, da ku dîmeneke ceribandî dubare bibe li şûna ku bi demdirêjiya vekirina sepanê ve girêdayî be.

column1: What aims each tilt: its own position, the picture's luma gradient so characters lean the way the image does, or the cell's hue.
column2: Çi her xwarbûnê arasteyî dike: cihê wê, gradienta ronahiyê ya wêneyê da ku tîp wekî wêneyê xwar bibin, an rengê şaneyê.

column1: Name a channel or a pair once. Playlists send to the name, so a different interface means changing the names here, not every cue.
column2: Navê kenalekê an cotekê carekê bide. Lîste ji navê re dişînin, ji ber vê navrûyeke din tê wateya guhertina navan li vir, ne her cue.

column1: Click a crosspoint to walk it: off, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Drag it sideways for any level. A playlist with none plays to its own device.
column2: Li xala hevbirrînê bitikîne ji bo guhertinê: girtî, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Bi alî ve bikişîne ji bo her astê. Lîsteya bê xal li amûra xwe lê dide.

column1: Sprite sets installed in data/sprites. Each folder there is a set; cycling picks one and wraps back to none. Right-click turns them off.
column2: Komên sprite di data/sprites de. Her peldank li wir komek e; guhertin yekê hildibijêre û vedigere tune. Tikandina rast wan digire.

column1: Internal resolution, 1 chunkiest to 5 finest. This is an aesthetic control as much as a speed one -- the 8-bit look comes from big pixels.
column2: Çareseriya hundirîn, 1 herî stûr heta 5 herî zirav. Ev bi qasî kontrola lezê kontrola dîmenê ye -- dîmena 8-bit ji pîkselên mezin tê.

column1: Picture takes colour from the image. Green, amber and cyan are terminal phosphors. Palette locks the text to the selected hardware palette.
column2: Picture rengê ji wêneyê digire. Kesk, zer û şînê vekirî fosforên termînalê ne. Palette nivîsê bi paleta hardware ya hilbijartî ve girê dide.

column1: SUBTLE self-heals (H.264). CLASSIC is the real smear (MPEG-4). EXTREME is chunkier and smears constantly. Changing this re-prepares the cue.
column2: SUBTLE xwe baş dike (H.264). CLASSIC lekeya rastîn e (MPEG-4). EXTREME stûrtir e û her tim leke dike. Guhertina vê cue ji nû ve amade dike.

column1: Sine for line-up, pink to ring out a PA, white to find rattles, sweep to hear where a room rings, identify to walk the outputs one at a time.
column2: Sine ji bo rêzkirinê, pink ji bo sazkirina PA, white ji bo dîtina lerzînan, sweep ji bo bihîstina ka ode li ku deng dide, identify ji bo derbasbûna derketinan yek bi yek.

column1: Which effect, by its place in the stack of the cue that deck is playing when this fires. With nothing there, the fade says so and does nothing
column2: Kîjan bandor, li gor cihê wê di stûna cue de ku ew deck dema ev dest pê dike lê dide. Ger tiştek tune be, hêdîbûn vê dibêje û tiştek nake

column1: Each frame blended into the next. This is the Hypno signature -- at 0 it is a pattern generator, above it the picture starts feeding on itself.
column2: Her wêne di yê din de têkel dibe. Ev îmzeya Hypno ye -- li 0 hilberînerê şablonan e, li jor wê wêne dest pê dike xwe bixwe.

column1: What is through the window on the hearth wall: a garden, rain, snow or the sea. A room with weather outside reads as somewhere rather than as a wall
column2: Di pencereya li ser dîwarê ocaxê de çi heye: baxçe, baran, berf an derya. Odeyek bi hewaya derve wekî cihekî tê xwendin ne wekî dîwarekî

column1: BY FIXTURE: the lights in the patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), by name. CHANNELS: channel=level by hand. A cue can carry both; channels go last
column2: LI GOR RONAHIYÊ: ronahiyên di patch de (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), bi navê. KENAL: kenal=ast bi destan. Cue dikare herduyan hilgire; kenal dawî tên

column1: Each character rocks as though it were a card being tilted. Every cell has its own phase, so the grid breathes instead of sliding about as one sheet.
column2: Her tîp wekî kartekê ku tê xwarkirin dihejîne. Her şaneyek qonaxa xwe heye, ji ber vê tor nefes digire li şûna ku wekî pelekî bişemite.

column1: Pen: click for corners, drag for curves, click the first point to close (P). Points: drag, click the outline to add one, Alt-click or Delete to remove
column2: Pênûs: ji bo goşeyan bitikîne, ji bo kevanan bikişîne, li xala yekem bitikîne ji bo girtinê (P). Xal: bikişîne, li ser xêzê bitikîne ji bo zêdekirinê, Alt-tikandin an Delete ji bo jêbirinê

column1: The chip's three channels. They differ in kind: triangle has no volume control on the hardware, and noise is a shift register rather than an oscillator.
column2: Sê kenalên çîpê. Ji hev cuda ne: triangle li ser hardware kontrola dengê nîne, û noise tomarkereke guherînê ye ne osîlator.

column1: Scanlines, phosphor bloom and RGB fringing. The bloom is the part that matters -- a phosphor spills sideways, which is why a CRT looks like it is emitting light.

column1: Torn scanline bands and RGB separation. In text mode it also corrupts CELLS -- whole rows lock to one repeating character, the way a real text screen loses sync.

column1: Scope shows shape and clipping. Lissajous shows phase and polarity between the first two channels -- a diagonal the wrong way means one is inverted. Spectrum is third-octave bars.
column2: Scope şikil û birrînê nîşan dide. Lissajous qonax û polariteyê di navbera du kenalên yekem de nîşan dide -- xêzeke berevajî tê wateya ku yek berevajî ye. Spectrum darikên sêyeka oktavê ye.

column1: 0 picks the glyph the brightness asks for, 1 picks any glyph in the set. Turn it up to see the whole alphabet: ranked strictly by ink, a flat area picks one mark and the rest never appear.
column2: 0 glyph a ku ronahî dixwaze hildibijêre, 1 her glyph a di komê de. Bilind bike da ku tevahiya alfabeyê bibînî: bi rêzkirina hişk li gor mîrekê, deverek rast yek nîşanê hildibijêre û yên din qet xuya nabin.

column1: Blocks and dithers read as density; the ASCII ramp reads as text; symbols read as wreckage. Cycling this clears a custom glyph string, since that would override it -- the preset row puts one back.
column2: Blok û dither wekî tîrbûnê tên xwendin; rampa ASCII wekî nivîsê; sembol wekî bermahiyan. Guhertina vê rêzika glyph a taybet paqij dike, ji ber ku ew ê wê derbas bike -- rêza pêşsazê yekê vedigerîne.

column1: Equal temperament buys free modulation at the cost of every interval being slightly wrong. Just and pythagorean are exactly in tune in one key. Bohlen-Pierce divides a twelfth, so it has no octaves.
column2: Akorta wekhev modulasyona azad bi bihayê ku her navber hinekî şaş be dikire. Akorta rast û pythagorean di yek tonê de bi tevahî rast in. Bohlen-Pierce dozdehekê dabeş dike, ji ber vê oktava wê tune.

column1: Both are live now: the replay underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Niha herdu zindî ne: dubare li bin, hibr li ser.

column1: We're on the air. Nobody touches the pen but me.
column2: Em di weşanê de ne. Ji min pê ve kes dest nade pênûsê.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then circle number 22 on the programme monitor. He is the yellow one.
column2: Di lêkolînerê de XÊZ BIKE bitikîne, paşê li monîtora bernameyê dora hejmara 22 bazinek bike. Yê zer e.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength.
column2: Zexta pênûsê xêzê stûrtir dike. Mişk tenê bi yek hêzê dide.

column1: Circle him! The yellow one! There's only one yellow one. Circle that one.
column2: Dora wî bike! Yê zer! Tenê yek zer heye. Dora wî bike!

column1: Draw as much as you like. Then SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, in the playlist.
column2: Bi qasî dilê xwe xêz bike. Paşê wêneyê tomar bike wêneyê bi paşxaneya şefaf di lîsteya lîstinê de diparêze.

column1: For next week's show. He will want that circle again.
column2: Ji bo pêşandana hefteya bê. Ew ê dîsa wê bazinê bixwaze.

column1: Put that in the Hall of Fame. Next to the turducken.
column2: Bixe salona navdaran. Li kêleka elokê tijî ordekê tijî mirîşkê.

column1: Halftime. Click the Deck 1 tab, then SOURCE, then Video Synth.
column2: Navber. Taba Deck 1 bitikîne, paşê ÇAVKANÎ, paşê Synth a vîdyoyê.

column1: My favourite source: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. A halftime show with no camera at all.
column2: Çavkaniya hezkirî: osîlator, neynik û vegerandin. Pêşandana navberê bê tu kamerayê.

column1: Halftime! Somebody get me some lights. And a band. And a sandwich.
column2: Navber! Yek ronahiyan bîne. Û komek muzîkê. Û sandwîçek.

column1: Select the synth and TAKE it. Then look at the monitor: your ink is still up.
column2: Synth hilbijêre û TAKE bike. Niha li monîtorê binêre: hibrê te hê li wir e.

column1: Playlist 2 did not change, so its ink stays over whatever playlist 1 shows. Each playlist changes on its own.
column2: Lîsteya lîstinê 2 neguherî, lewma hibrê wê li ser her tiştê lîsteya 1 nîşan dide dimîne. Her lîste bi xwe diguhere.

column1: Leave the circle up. It's a good circle. It goes with everything.
column2: Bazin bimîne. Bazinek baş e. Li her tiştî tê.

column1: A test pattern, a replay, ink on a layer, a still, and halftime. That's the booth.
column2: Nexşeya testê, dubare, hibr li ser qat, wêneyek sabît û navber. Kabîn ev e.

column1: Replay in the Draw section draws your lines back the way you drew them. He will love that.
column2: Replay di beşa XÊZ BIKE de xêzan wek te xêz kiribûn vedixêze. Ew ê hez bike.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen.
column2: Hefteya bê heman dem. Pênûseke mezintir bîne.

column1: Now THAT is a busy play. I can't see the field. I love it.
column2: Va tevgera qelebalix! Qadê nabînim. Ez hez dikim.

column1: Two projectors overlap, and each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright. Watch the sides of the monitor go soft.
column2: Du projektor li ser hev dikevin û her yek kenara xwe dimirîne da ronahiya hevpar du qat nebe. Nermbûna aliyên monîtorê bibîne.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and a host who is not here tonight. Press START.
column2: Pêşandana pirsan, skapi. Sê beşdar, yek dengder û mêvandarek ku îşev ne li vir e. DEST PÊ BIKE bitikîne.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines.
column2: Hejmarên cueyan, bişkokên kurt û GO ji makîneyên din.

column1: Forty years I turned the letters. Tonight they gave me the microphone. Nobody panic.
column2: Çil salan min tîp dizivirandin. Îşev mîkrofon dan min. Kes netirse.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Şano cueyan hejmar dike: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy hemûyan dixwîne.

column1: Numbers! I know letters. Numbers are letters that went to college.
column2: Hejmar! Ez tîpan dizanim. Hejmar tîpên çûne zanîngehê ne.

column1: GOTO crosses a long list faster than scrolling. Much faster.
column2: GOTO ji gerandina lîsteyeke dirêj lezgîntir e. Gelek lezgîntir.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one is a buzzer.
column2: F1 heta F10, F12 an klavyeya hejmaran. Her yek dengderek e.

column1: Every contestant gets a buzzer. I get the letters. It's fine. It's fine.
column2: Her beşdar dengderek distîne. Ez tîpan distînim. Baş e. Baş e.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Only the key.
column2: Bê mişk, bê lîste, bê nêrîn. Tenê bişkok.

column1: Buzz! A winner! I've never said that. I've only pointed at it.
column2: Bîp! Serketî! Min ev qet negotibû. Tenê min nîşan dabû.

column1: And for our viewers at home: yes, you can push the buttons too.
column2: Û ji temaşevanên li malê re: erê, hûn jî dikarin bişkokan bikirtînin.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You could host a game show now.
column2: Hejmar, GOTO, dengder û GO ji her derê. Niha tu dikarî mêvandarê pêşandana pirsan bî.

column1: Goodnight, everybody! Tomorrow I go back to the letters. I'll miss you.
column2: Şev baş, hemûyan! Sibê ez vedigerim tîpan. Ez ê bêriya we bikim.

column1: And the number is... not three. I'll allow it. I turn anything.
column2: Û hejmar... ne sê ye. Qebûl e. Ez her tiştî dizivirînim.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. For now.
column2: Lîsteya lîstinê ya duyem qatek li ser nexşeyê ye. Kezî li bin dimîne. Heya niha.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio.
column2: Lower Third, nav, karta sernavê, paşxane. Kezî ji studyoyê derket.

column1: That's not my name. It's a lovely name. Now, about that lizard...
column2: Ew ne navê min e. Navek xweş e. Niha, derbarê wê kezîyê de...

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, an inventor who wants cheese, and a dog who does the real work. Press START.
column2: Roketeke li jêrzemînê çêkirî, skapi, dahênerê penîrxwaz û kûçikek ku karê rast dike. DEST PÊ BIKE bitikîne.

column1: Stage timers: a countdown over a picture, a hold, and a view for the person on stage.
column2: Demjimêrên sehneyê: hejmartina paşve li ser wêneyê, rawestandin û dîmen ji bo kesê li ser sehneyê.

column1: Playlist 2 is selected, over the rocket. SOURCE, then Stage Timer.
column2: Lîsteya lîstinê 2 li ser roketê hat hilbijartin. ÇAVKANÎ, paşê Stage Timer.

column1: *checks his watch, then the rocket, then his watch*
column2: *li saeta xwe dinêre, paşê roketê, paşê saeta xwe*

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. I have cleared its backdrop, so the rocket shows behind the numbers.
column2: Demjimêrê hilbijêre û TAKE bike. Min paşxane jê biriye da roket li pişt hejmaran xuya bike.

column1: Past zero it keeps going and counts the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Piştî sifirê jî diçe û dema zêde dihejmêre. Pir rastgo ye. Hinek bêedeb.

column1: Close MENU, click the Deck 1 tab, then select 'The rocket (lift-off)' and TAKE it.
column2: MENÛ bigire, taba Deck 1 bitikîne, paşê 'The rocket (lift-off)' hilbijêre û TAKE bike.

column1: The clock is on playlist 2, so it stays up while the rocket changes underneath it.
column2: Saet li lîsteya lîstinê 2 ye, lewma dimîne dema roket li bin diguhere.

column1: We have lift-off, Grommet! ...Grommet? Who's flying it?
column2: Em firiyan, Grommet! ...Grommet? Kî wê diajo?

column1: A countdown, a hold, a pilot's view and a launch. Bring crackers.
column2: Hejmartina paşve, rawestandin, dîmena pîlot û firîn. Biskuwît bîne.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a rubber chicken, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Pêşandana efsûnê, skapi. Sindoq, mirîşka lastîkî û lêdanek ku her tişt pê re diguhere. DEST PÊ BIKE bitikîne.

column1: Two playlists are two layers, and TAKE ALL changes both together. Tonight you will see why that matters.
column2: Du lîsteyên lîstinê du qat in û TAKE ALL herduyan bi hev diguherîne. Îşev tu ê girîngiya wê bibînî.

column1: The chicken goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Mirîşk di qata xwe de ye. + li dawiya tabên lîsteya lîstinê bitikîne.

column1: The lit tab is the playlist that gets the next cue. Its chip now says 'to Out 1': it is layered over playlist 1 on that output.
column2: Taba ronî lîsteya cueya bê distîne ye. Nîşana wê niha 'ji bo Derketin 1' dibêje: li wê derketinê li ser lîsteya 1 ye.

column1: Turnip Top has put the chicken in playlist 2. In playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Then in playlist 2, TAKE the chicken.
column2: Turnip Top mirîşk xistiye lîsteya lîstinê 2. Di lîsteya 1 de 'The trunk (open)' TAKE bike. Paşê di lîsteya 2 de mirîşk TAKE bike.

column1: The chicken is clear all round, so it covers only itself. Watch the monitor between the two TAKEs.
column2: Dora mirîşkê şefaf e, tenê cihê xwe digire. Di navbera du TAKE de li monîtorê binêre.

column1: Did you see it? For a moment the trunk was open and empty: two TAKEs are two moments. The trick is reset. Now select the open trunk in playlist 1 and the chicken in playlist 2, then TAKE ALL.
column2: Dîtî? Demekê sindoq vekirî û vala bû: du TAKE du dem in. Fêl hat nûkirin. Niha sindoqa vekirî di lîsteya 1 û mirîşk di lîsteya 2 de hilbijêre, paşê TAKE ALL.

column1: TAKE ALL takes every playlist's selected cue on one beat. No gap, no empty trunk.
column2: TAKE ALL cueya hilbijartî ya her lîsteyê bi yek lêdanê tîne. Bê navber, bê sindoqa vala.

column1: The chicken was late. They saw an empty trunk. In magic we call that a trunk.
column2: Mirîşk dereng ma. Sindoqa vala dîtin. Di efsûnê de em jê re sindoq dibêjin.

column1: Trick two. Drag playlist 2's opacity fader down to nothing. The chicken fades away.
column2: Fêla duyem. Fadera nezelaliya lîsteya lîstinê 2 heta sifirê bikişîne xwarê. Mirîşk dimire.

column1: Every playlist has its own opacity. Down is a fade out, with no cue at all.
column2: Her lîste nezelaliya xwe heye. Ber bi xwarê windabûn e, bê tu cueyê.

column1: Ta-daaa! ...Hold for applause. Hold. Now watch it go.
column2: Ta-daaa! ...Li benda çepikan bimîne. Bimîne. Niha çûyîna wê bibîne.

column1: Trick three. Bring it back: playlist 2's opacity all the way up.
column2: Fêla sêyem. Vegerîne: nezelaliya lîsteya lîstinê 2 heta dawî bilind bike.

column1: Where did it go? Back in the trunk. Everything goes back in the trunk.
column2: Çû ku? Vegeriya sindoqê. Her tişt vedigere sindoqê.

column1: An appearance done wrong, then right, a vanish and a return. Nazdrave.
column2: Xuyabûna şaş, paşê rast, windabûn û veger. Nazdrave.

column1: A playlist can also sit on any output. Two layers, a great many tricks.
column2: Lîsteya lîstinê dikare li her derketinê jî be. Du qat, gelek fêl.

column1: It's back! Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Vegeriya! Spas! Ez tevahiya hefteyê li vir im! Mirîşk her û her li vir e!

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. The kitchen is on fire. Press START.
column2: Pêşandana çêkirina xwarinê, skapi. Zindî. Metbex dişewite. DEST PÊ BIKE bitikîne.

column1: Bork! De fire extinguisher is also on fire!
BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen.
column2: reş ji bo veşartinê, PANIC ji bo rawestandinê, TAKE ji bo vegerê. Tu ji her metbexê sax derdikevî.

column1: A fashion show, skapi. One designer, one runway, and a look she will want back. Press START.
column2: Pêşandana modayê, skapi. Dîzaynerek, rêyek û dîmenek ku wê dîsa bixwaze. DEST PÊ BIKE bitikîne.

column1: A preset stores a whole look and brings it back with one button.
column2: Pêşsaz dîmenek tevahî diparêze û bi yek bişkokê vedigerîne.

column1: Darling. A look is not a look until you can get it back.
column2: Delalê. Dîmen ne dîmen e heta tu bikaribî vegerînî.

column1: Buttons. Good. I design with buttons.
column2: Bişkok. Baş e. Ez bi bişkokan dîzayn dikim.

column1: Store it. Before somebody has ideas.
column2: Biparêze. Berî ku fikrek bikeve serê yekî.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it.
column2: DASH bigire (Esc), paşê Look two hilbijêre û TAKE bike.

column1: A cape. On my runway. Someone will trip, darling. Someone always trips.
column2: Pelerin. Li ser rêya min. Yek ê bikeve, delalê. Her car yek dikeve.

column1: Recall: the whole look comes back at once.
column2: Vexwendin: dîmena tevahî bi carekê vedigere.

column1: Thank you. We will never speak of the cape again.
column2: Spas. Em ê êdî qet qala pelerinê nekin.

column1: Simple. Timeless. Recallable. Now go, darling. I have a fitting.
column2: Hêsan. Bêdem. Vegerbar. Niha here, delalê. Ez pîvana cilê dikim.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white, and more. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Paldayîn, paqijkirin, îrîs, çûna spî û zêdetir. Min nîvê wan nivîsî. Roja sêşemê.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Roll credits.
column2: Şêwaz, dem û du hatinên pir dramatîk. Navên dawiyê bilîzin.

column1: That is not an iris. ...It is better. I will allow it.
column2: Ew ne îrîs e. ...Baştir e. Ez qebûl dikim.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Efekt, bend û patch. Ez dibêjim robot razî ne. Rûyên wan helmet in.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it. The agents did not.
column2: Şêweya pêlê, vektorskop, rengê derewîn. Pîvanan çareser kir. Ajanan nekir.

column1: Major Tomasina is in orbit, skapi, and her picture has to reach the ground. Press START.
column2: Major Tomasina di gergehê de ye, skapi, û wêneya wê divê bigihîje erdê. DEST PÊ BIKE bitikîne.

column1: Pictures leave by cable or network: NDI, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: Wêne bi kablo an torê diçin: NDI, SDI ji karta DeckLink û ST 2110 ji bo navendên weşanê.

column1: Ground control, this is Major Tomasina. Can you see my picture?
column2: Kontrola erdê, li vir Major Tomasina ye. Wêneya min dibînin?

column1: Every way down, on one page. Good. Space has very few cables.
column2: Hemû rêyên xwarê li yek rûpelê. Baş e. Valahî gelek kêm kablo heye.

column1: Sending now. If nobody answers, I'll just float here.
column2: Niha dişînim. Heke kes bersiv nede, ez ê li vir biherikim.

column1: Ground control, signing off. Tell my mother I waved.
column2: Kontrola erdê, ez diqetînim. Ji diya min re bêjin min dest hejand.

column1: Ground control can see me! I can see my house from here.
column2: Kontrola erdê min dibîne! Ji vir mala xwe dibînim.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late.
column2: Û pencereyek din ji bo saetê. Operatorê li saetê dinêre dereng namîne.

column1: The big window is window one, which is usually the programme.
column2: Pencereya mezin pencereya yek e, bi gelemperî bername ye.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved.
column2: Pencere, menûya ..., NEXT, saet, rêzkirin, tally. Sir hat çareserkirin.

column1: FX CHOICE: choice must be A or B
column2: FX CHOICE: hilbijartin divê A an B be

column1: FX CHOICE: no effect at that index
column2: FX CHOICE: li wê rêzê efekt tune
